66309.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中大型不成熟細胞的細胞質豐富呈灰藍色、偶見空泡，細胞核細緻並有折疊或花瓣狀（苜蓿葉狀）分葉，屬單核母細胞與前單核球 (promonocytes)，提示伴單核球分化的急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Large immature cells with moderate to abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and variable N:C ratio
Nuclei round to indented, with several showing folded or cloverleaf/lobulated contours (promonocytes)
Fine, lacy immature chromatin with faint nucleoli
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles; no Auer rods seen
Background red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with some hypochromia; one small mature lymphocyte present
66309.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous large immature mononuclear cells with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, occasional cytoplasmic vacuoles and fine immature chromatin. Many cells have indented, folded or cloverleaf-shaped nuclei characteristic of promonocytes, admixed with rounder blast forms; Auer rods are not identified. Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with hypochromia. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation, supported by expression of CD64 and CD11c on flow cytometry; nonspecific esterase cytochemistry can further confirm monocytic lineage.

ddx.vs: CMML shows mostly mature monocytes with blasts plus promonocytes <20%, whereas here blasts and promonocytes predominate.
Microgranular APL cells also have folded bilobed nuclei but are strongly MPO positive, NSE negative, and CD34/HLA-DR negative, unlike these HLA-DR-positive cells.
Reactive monocytes have condensed chromatin, vacuolated cytoplasm and no increase in blasts or promonocytes.
AMML requires ≥20% neutrophil lineage cells in addition to monocytic cells, which requires a differential count rather than a single field.

66373.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中散在數個細胞質膨大、淡染的組織球，裡面塞滿許多細小的點狀嗜鹼性顆粒，各有一圈淡色暈；在造血細胞與脂肪之間看到這些「點點狀」組織球，應想到組織漿菌感染，並以 GMS 染色確認。
features: Scattered histiocytes with expanded pale cytoplasm packed with numerous tiny (about 2-4 um) basophilic dot-like organisms with pale halos
Organisms are uniform and predominantly intracellular, with rare possible extracellular forms
Hypercellular hematopoietic marrow with erythroid and myeloid precursors between adipocytes
A megakaryocyte at the left edge and dilated sinusoids in the upper left
No well-formed granulomas or necrosis in this field
66373.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine section shows cellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis, adipocytes, and dilated sinusoids. Scattered among the hematopoietic cells are histiocytes with expanded pale cytoplasm containing numerous tiny, uniform basophilic dot-like organisms, approximately 2-4 um, each with a pale halo. The organisms are predominantly intracellular, and no well-formed granulomas or necrosis are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow infiltration by intracellular yeasts, compatible with disseminated histoplasmosis; confirmation with GMS/PAS stains and culture or antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania-laden macrophages look similar on H&E, but amastigotes show a kinetoplast on Giemsa and are GMS-negative.
Talaromyces yeasts are elongated with transverse septa on GMS, rather than uniform oval budding forms.
Infected histiocytes show striated, pseudo-Gaucher cytoplasm with AFB-positive bacilli rather than haloed dot-like yeasts.
Histiocytes contain ingested red cells, nuclear debris, or whole hematopoietic cells rather than uniform tiny organisms.

66181.recognize_zh: 中上方的細胞有偏心圓形核、染色質呈塊狀，胞質豐富呈紫藍色，邊緣毛糙呈火焰狀突起並略帶粉紫色，符合火焰細胞（flame cell，富含免疫球蛋白的漿細胞）；但此張胞質紅紫色調不算明顯，需搭配臨床判讀。
features: Plasma cell with eccentric round nucleus and coarsely clumped chromatin
Abundant lilac-blue cytoplasm with frayed, flame-like projections and faint pinkish-purple peripheral tint
No distinct paranuclear hof visible in this cell
Adjacent cells include a granulated myelocyte, a plasmacytoid cell with pale blue cytoplasm and immature myeloid/erythroid cells in a cellular particle at lower right
Background crenated red cells with refractile drying artifact
66181.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a plasma cell with an eccentric round nucleus, clumped chromatin and abundant lilac-blue cytoplasm with frayed, flame-like margins and a faint reddish-purple peripheral tinge, consistent with a flame cell. Nearby are a granulated myelocyte, a second plasmacytoid cell with pale blue cytoplasm and several hematopoietic precursors. Red cells show crenation and drying artifact, which limits color assessment. Findings are consistent with a flame cell; this morphology is classically associated with IgA-secreting plasma cells but is not specific and may occur in reactive plasmacytosis, so plasma cell percentage, clonality and serum protein studies are needed.

ddx.dx: Mott cell / Russell body plasma cell
ddx.vs: Mott cells contain multiple round pale-blue Russell bodies (grape-like) rather than diffuse fuchsia-staining cytoplasm with frayed edges.
Megakaryocytic cells have granular pink cytoplasm with budding platelets and lobulated or dense nuclei rather than a round eccentric clock-face nucleus.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm, lacking eccentric clumped nucleus.
Thesaurocytes are large plasma cells with abundant pale-to-blue cytoplasm and a pushed-aside nucleus without flame-colored peripheral staining.

65925.recognize_zh: 紅箭頭所指細胞大小與嗜中性球相近，細胞質布滿粗大、深紫色的嗜鹼性顆粒並覆蓋於核上，使核形不清，即嗜鹼性球（basophil）；左側為分葉核嗜中性球可作對照。
features: Cell (arrow) similar in size to a neutrophil with coarse, dark purple basophilic granules
Granules densely overlie and partially obscure the nucleus, so lobation is not clearly visible
Small paler cytoplasmic area at one pole with fewer granules
Adjacent segmented neutrophil with fine pale granules for comparison
Normochromic red cells with scattered platelets
65925.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells, scattered platelets, and a segmented neutrophil. The indicated cell is of similar size and contains numerous coarse, dark purple cytoplasmic granules that overlie and partially obscure the nucleus, consistent with a basophil. No blasts or immature granulocytes are seen in this field. In a patient with chronic myeloid leukemia, basophilia is a characteristic finding, and a basophil count ≥20% is a WHO-HAEM4 accelerated-phase criterion.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are larger with a round central nucleus and uniformly packed granules and are rarely seen in blood.
Toxic neutrophils have a clearly visible segmented nucleus with finer dark granules not obscuring it.
Eosinophils contain larger refractile orange-red granules with a bilobed nucleus clearly visible.
An immature basophil has a round, non-segmented nucleus with finer chromatin, whereas a mature basophil has a lobated nucleus.

65861.recognize_zh: 三顆嗜中性球都分葉不足：右上一顆為兩個圓葉以細絲相連的夾鼻眼鏡狀，左上與下方兩顆核呈腎形/C 形不分葉；它們的染色質都是成熟的粗塊狀，與帶狀核不同，符合假性 Pelger-Huët 變化。
features: Three neutrophils with hyposegmented nuclei
One classic pince-nez bilobed nucleus with two round lobes joined by a thin strand
Two cells with unsegmented kidney- or C-shaped nuclei
Coarse, clumped mature chromatin in all cells
Cytoplasmic granulation preserved
Background red cells with drying artifact; scattered platelets and small platelet clumps
65861.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three neutrophils with hyposegmented nuclei, including one bilobed pince-nez form and two cells with unsegmented kidney- or C-shaped nuclei. All show coarsely clumped mature chromatin and preserved granulation. Red cells show drying artifact only and platelets are present. The mature chromatin pattern despite reduced lobation distinguishes these from band forms; in the setting of infection-related leukocytosis, findings are consistent with reactive pseudo-Pelger-Huët change.

ddx.vs: Bands show a C-shaped nucleus of uniform width with finer, less condensed chromatin, whereas these unsegmented nuclei already have mature clumped chromatin.
The inherited form affects nearly all neutrophils persistently and is familial; morphology alone cannot distinguish it.
MDS typically adds hypogranulation, cytopenias and dysplasia of other lineages.

64837.recognize_zh: 未染色血液在螢光顯微鏡下，紅血球整體呈紅色螢光，且散佈多顆發出更亮、均勻紅橙色螢光的紅血球（fluorocytes），代表紅血球內卟啉（porphyrin）大量堆積，支持紅血球生成型卟啉症。
features: Unstained peripheral blood film viewed under fluorescence microscopy (mercury lamp excitation)
Diffuse red fluorescence of the red cell population
Scattered red cells with markedly brighter, homogeneous red-orange fluorescence (fluorocytes)
Two small intensely yellow-orange fluorescent bodies, of uncertain nature at this resolution
Circular dark border reflects the microscope field diaphragm
64837.describe_en: Fluorescence microscopy of unstained fetal peripheral blood shows red fluorescence of the red cell population, with numerous scattered cells showing intense homogeneous red-orange fluorescence (fluorocytes). Two small, very bright yellow-orange fluorescent bodies are also present, but their nature cannot be determined from this image. The reported emission in the 615-617 nm range corresponds to porphyrin fluorescence. Findings indicate marked erythrocyte porphyrin accumulation, consistent with an erythropoietic porphyria such as congenital erythropoietic porphyria, to be confirmed by porphyrin fractionation and genetic testing.

ddx.vs: EPP fluorocytes are transient and fade rapidly, with free protoporphyrin elevated, whereas CEP accumulates uroporphyrin I and coproporphyrin I and is usually associated with hemolysis.
Elevated zinc protoporphyrin gives only weak fluorescence without prominent fluorocytes, and smears show basophilic stippling or microcytosis.
Nonspecific autofluorescence is weak and uniform, lacking bright cell-restricted fluorescence in the porphyrin emission window.

64709.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中有數顆大型細胞，細胞質佈滿密集的深紫紅色粗顆粒，顆粒甚至覆蓋細胞核，核輪廓略呈摺疊或凹陷；這種高顆粒性的「異常前骨髓細胞」而非真正原始細胞，是 APL 的典型外觀。
features: Several large cells with abundant cytoplasm, two to three times the diameter of red cells
Cytoplasm densely packed with coarse purple-red azurophilic granules that overlie and obscure the nucleus
Nuclei with irregular, folded or indented outlines; chromatin partly obscured by granules
Nucleoli not discernible; Auer rod bundles not clearly seen in this field
Cells occur singly and in pairs; no mature neutrophils in this field
Background red cells normocytic; platelets sparse
64709.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large abnormal myeloid cells, occurring singly and in pairs, with abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules that obscure the nuclear detail. Where visible, nuclei are irregular with folded or indented contours. Auer rods are not clearly identified in this field, and mature neutrophils are not seen. Findings are consistent with hypergranular abnormal promyelocytes of acute promyelocytic leukemia with PML::RARA; urgent coagulation studies and genetic confirmation are indicated.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts in AML with maturation have round nuclei, visible nucleoli and fewer granules, with maturing granulocytes present.
Toxic neutrophils are segmented mature cells with dark granules, not large cells with coarse granules obscuring an immature nucleus.
Basophil granules are dark purple-black and water-soluble around a lobated nucleus, and mast cells have a round central nucleus with metachromatic granules.
Normal promyelocytes have a visible round nucleus with nucleoli and a perinuclear Golgi hof, and granules do not obscure the nucleus.

65029.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中下排牙齦明顯腫脹增生、呈暗紅至紫紅色，牙齦邊緣肥厚往上覆蓋部分牙冠，呈分葉狀；廣泛性牙齦浸潤是急性骨髓性白血病單核球分化亞型的經典臨床線索。
features: Diffuse swelling and hypertrophy of the mandibular gingiva
Erythematous to violaceous, lobulated gingival margins partly covering the tooth crowns
Involvement of multiple interdental papillae in a continuous band
No obvious ulceration, necrosis, or active bleeding in this view
Upper gingiva less clearly visualized
65029.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the oral cavity shows diffuse hypertrophy of the mandibular gingiva with erythematous to violaceous, lobulated margins that partially cover the crowns of the lower teeth. The enlargement involves multiple interdental papillae in a continuous band, without obvious ulceration or necrosis in this view. Diffuse gingival enlargement of this type in a patient with acute leukemia is consistent with leukemic infiltration, characteristic of AML with monocytic differentiation; bone marrow evaluation with nonspecific esterase and flow cytometry confirms the subtype.

ddx.dx: Drug-induced gingival overgrowth (phenytoin, cyclosporine, calcium channel blockers)
ddx.vs: Drug-induced overgrowth is firm, pink, and fibrotic with a relevant medication history and normal blood counts.
Inflammatory gingivitis shows localized marginal redness and bleeding without diffuse bulky enlargement or leukemic blasts.
Scurvy causes swollen, hemorrhagic gingiva with perifollicular hemorrhages and low vitamin C rather than leukemic infiltration.
GPA shows granular red-purple petechial gingiva with ANCA positivity and granulomatous vasculitis on biopsy.

65605.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中的芽細胞核有折疊、細胞質深藍並有核旁淡染區（hof），外觀類似 t(8;21) AML；流式 CD34/CD19 陽性也相似，但 FISH 顯示 RUNX1 三個訊號而非 RUNX1::RUNX1T1 融合，最後由光學基因組圖譜確認 RUNX1::CBFA2T3。
features: Large blasts with folded or indented nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof (panel A)
Occasional myeloid cell with coarse salmon/orange cytoplasmic granules; no Auer rods seen
Flow cytometry: CD34+/CD38+, CD117+ with partial CD19, CD33+/CD13+, CD22 and CD10 negative (panel B)
Karyotype with arrows on chromosomes 1, 16, and 21 indicating der(1;15) and t(16;21)(q24;q22) (panel C)
FISH with extra RUNX1 signal and break-apart split, and circos plot of optical genome mapping showing inter-chromosomal fusions (panels D-F)
65605.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased blasts with folded nuclei, prominent nucleoli, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and perinuclear hofs, with an occasional cell containing coarse salmon-colored granules; Auer rods are not seen. Flow cytometry shows CD34+, CD117+, CD13+, CD33+ myeloid blasts with aberrant partial CD19 expression. The karyotype shows t(16;21)(q24;q22) and der(1;15), FISH is negative for RUNX1::RUNX1T1 but shows an extra RUNX1 signal and a RUNX1 break-apart pattern, and optical genome mapping identifies RUNX1::CBFA2T3. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with RUNX1::CBFA2T3 fusion, a t(8;21)-like entity, here in a therapy-related setting.

ddx.vs: Morphology and CD19/CD34 phenotype overlap closely, and separation requires FISH or RT-PCR showing RUNX1::RUNX1T1 fusion, which is negative here.
MPAL requires strong B-lineage markers (bright CD19 with CD79a, CD22, or CD10), whereas these blasts are CD22/CD10 negative with only partial CD19.
This shows multilineage dysplasia and MDS-type cytogenetics rather than a t(16;21) RUNX1 fusion.

65285.recognize_zh: 中央四顆緊貼的紅系前驅細胞：下方為細顆粒染色質、深藍細胞質的早期細胞，右側大細胞染色質已呈粗塊但核仍大，展示同一視野內不同成熟階段且細胞偏大；左側有破碎的網狀細胞殘骸，背景為卵圓形與淚滴形紅血球，符合巨母紅血球性貧血。
features: Cluster of four erythroid precursors at different maturation stages
Early basophilic precursor with finely stippled chromatin and deep blue cytoplasm (bottom)
Large later-stage erythroblast with coarsely clumped chromatin but persistently large nucleus (right), indicating asynchrony
Smaller basophilic and polychromatic precursors (left and top)
Smeared fibrillar cellular debris at left; small dense nucleated cell at top right
Background oval macrocytes and teardrop cells
65285.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of erythroid precursors spanning early basophilic to later polychromatic stages. The cells are enlarged, and the more mature erythroblast retains a large nucleus with partially condensed chromatin while its cytoplasm is hemoglobinizing, indicating nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony. A smeared cell with fibrillar debris lies at the left, and the background shows oval macrocytes and teardrop cells. The findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis in B12/folate deficiency.

ddx.vs: MDS may show megaloblastoid erythroblasts but also nuclear budding, internuclear bridging, ring sideroblasts and clonal cytogenetics with normal vitamin levels.
Normoblastic precursors decrease in size synchronously with chromatin condensation and lack the giant, open-chromatin forms seen here.
Drug-induced megaloblastosis is morphologically identical and is distinguished by medication history with normal B12/folate levels.

65221.recognize_zh: 紅血球背景中一條細長彎曲、深藍色的線狀蟲體，體內充滿核柱，前端外側可見淡藍色鞘膜延伸，尾端逐漸變細；有鞘、體態平滑彎曲的微絲蟲（microfilaria），配合臨床符合班氏絲蟲（Wuchereria bancrofti）。
features: Elongated, gracefully curved thread-like organism many times the length of a red cell diameter
Body filled with a column of deeply basophilic nuclei
Pale blue sheath visibly extending beyond the anterior end
Tapering tail that thins to a fine point, apparently free of nuclei at the tip (resolution-limited)
Dense red cell background typical of a thick area of blood film
65221.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single microfilaria lying among densely packed red cells. The organism is long and smoothly curved, with a column of basophilic nuclei and a pale staining sheath projecting beyond the anterior end, and a tail that tapers to a fine point. Image resolution does not allow reliable assessment of the terminal nuclei or cephalic space. The findings are consistent with a sheathed microfilaria, suggestive of Wuchereria bancrofti in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: Brugia microfilariae are also sheathed but show kinks, a pink-staining sheath on Giemsa, and two separate terminal nuclei in the tail, whereas W. bancrofti has a smooth curve with no nuclei at the tail tip.
Loa loa microfilariae are sheathed but have nuclei extending continuously to the tail tip and circulate by day.
Mansonella microfilariae are smaller, unsheathed, and have a blunt tail with nuclei to the tip.

65157.recognize_zh: 中倍下母細胞樣細胞的細胞核偏心、染色質細緻，灰藍色無顆粒細胞質集中在細胞一側呈新月形或尾巴狀，形成類似漿細胞的「plasmacytoid」外觀，是 BPDCN 常見的抹片表現。
features: Medium-sized blastoid cells, roughly 1.5-2 times a small lymphocyte
Round to oval, eccentrically placed nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Agranular grey-blue cytoplasm polarized to one pole, forming crescentic caps or tail-like extensions
Occasional cells with irregular, slightly lobulated nuclear outline
Scattered small mature lymphocytes/nucleated red cells for size comparison; red cells without significant abnormality
65157.describe_en: Wright-stained smear at intermediate magnification shows numerous medium-sized blastoid cells with eccentric round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cytoplasm is agranular and grey-blue, characteristically polarized to one side of the cell as a crescent or tail-like projection, conferring a plasmacytoid appearance. No Auer rods, cytoplasmic granules or dysplastic granulocytes are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm in the context of the CD4+/CD56+/CD123+ immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts often have more abundant cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and nonspecific esterase positivity, and lack bright CD123/TCF4/TCL1 expression.
Plasma cells have clumped clock-face chromatin, deep basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof rather than fine blastic chromatin with pale polarized cytoplasm, and are CD138+/CD38 bright.
Lymphoblasts have scantier cytoplasm and are TdT and CD19/cCD79a or cCD3 positive, all negative here.

65093.recognize_zh: 淋巴結濾泡間區充滿大量增生的小血管，內皮細胞肥厚突出，並夾雜紅血球外滲；畫面中央可見小淋巴球呈同心圓（洋蔥皮樣）排列包圍萎縮、玻璃樣變的生發中心。
features: Marked interfollicular vascular proliferation of small capillaries and venules
Plump, prominent endothelial cells lining numerous vessels
Regressed follicle with concentric onion-skin layering of small mantle lymphocytes around a hyalinized center
Interspersed small lymphocytes, scattered plasma cells and extravasated red blood cells
Effaced-appearing, hypervascular architecture without sheets of atypical large cells
65093.describe_en: Lymph node section at 20x shows a hypervascular interfollicular region with numerous proliferating small vessels lined by plump endothelial cells, accompanied by small lymphocytes, occasional plasma cells and extravasated red cells. A regressed follicle is present centrally, with small mantle lymphocytes arranged in concentric onion-skin layers around a hyalinized, depleted germinal center. There is no infiltrate of atypical large cells. Findings are consistent with the hypervascular variant of Castleman disease-like histology, as described in TAFRO syndrome.

ddx.vs: AITL also shows arborizing high endothelial venules, but it contains clusters of atypical clear T cells expressing CD10/PD-1/CXCL13 and expanded CD21-positive FDC meshworks around vessels, with clonal TCR rearrangement.
Morphology overlaps, but unicentric disease presents as a solitary mass without systemic inflammation, thrombocytopenia, anasarca or organomegaly.
Kaposi sarcoma forms fascicles of spindle cells with slit-like vascular spaces and hyaline globules that are HHV-8 LANA-1 positive.

64901.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中細胞呈間隔均勻的排列，每顆細胞中央為圓到橢圓形小核，四周圍著一圈透明淡染胞質，形成「荷包蛋（fried egg）」外觀，並散見褐色含鐵血黃素與紅血球滲出，符合毛細胞白血病浸潤。
features: Diffuse interstitial infiltrate of evenly spaced mononuclear cells
Round to oval or slightly indented nuclei with bland chromatin
Abundant clear to pale cytoplasm separating nuclei, producing a fried-egg appearance
Extravasated red cells in pink stroma (red cell lakes)
Scattered coarse brown hemosiderin deposits
64901.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine shows a hypercellular marrow with a diffuse interstitial infiltrate of monotonous small to medium-sized cells. The cells have round to oval, sometimes indented nuclei with bland chromatin, and abundant clear cytoplasm that keeps the nuclei widely spaced, producing a characteristic fried-egg appearance. The background shows extravasated red cells and scattered hemosiderin. Findings are consistent with involvement by hairy cell leukemia; confirmation with CD20, annexin A1, CD25/CD123, and reticulin staining is recommended.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are spindle or oval with granular cytoplasm, form paratrabecular or perivascular aggregates with fibrosis and eosinophils, and are tryptase and CD117 positive.
SMZL typically forms intrasinusoidal and nodular infiltrates of cells with less abundant cytoplasm rather than a diffuse widely spaced fried-egg pattern.

ddx.dx: Hypocellular myelodysplastic neoplasm or aplastic anemia
ddx.vs: These lack a monotonous lymphoid infiltrate; HCL can mimic hypocellularity, which is resolved by CD20 and annexin A1 IHC.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clockface chromatin and amphophilic cytoplasm rather than central nuclei with clear cytoplasm.

64773.recognize_zh: 組合圖中周邊血可見雙葉核（bilobed）且細胞質佈滿粗大嗜天青顆粒的異常前骨髓球，MPO 細胞化學強陽性，流式呈 SSC 偏高、CD34−、HLA-DR−、CD117 弱、cMPO 強陽性，屬典型 APL 表型；本例 FISH 與核型皆未見 PML::RARA，需靠 NGS 融合基因檢測確認。
features: PB: large atypical promyelocytes with bilobed/folded (butterfly-like) nuclei and cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules
BM biopsy H&E: sheets of cells with moderate eosinophilic granular cytoplasm and oval to folded nuclei
MPO cytochemistry: intense, coarse blue-green granular positivity filling the cytoplasm; MPO IHC also positive
Flow: CD45-dim population with high side scatter, CD34 negative, HLA-DR negative, CD117 partially dim, CD33 bright, CD64 dim/partial, CD14 negative, cytoplasmic MPO bright
Morphology and immunophenotype alone cannot distinguish cryptic PML::RARA from RARA-variant or APL-like AML
64773.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (A-C) shows abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed to folded nuclei and abundant cytoplasm containing numerous coarse azurophilic granules. Bone marrow biopsy (D) shows sheets of immature granulated myeloid cells, and cytochemical and immunohistochemical MPO stains are strongly positive (E-F). Flow cytometry (G-L) demonstrates a CD45-dim, high side scatter population that is CD34-negative, HLA-DR-negative, CD33 bright, CD117 dim/partial, CD14-negative, and bright cytoplasmic MPO-positive. The morphology and immunophenotype are characteristic of acute promyelocytic leukemia; because FISH and karyotype were negative for t(15;17), confirmation of a cryptic PML::RARA fusion by RT-PCR or NGS fusion panel is required.

ddx.vs: NPM1-mutated AML can be CD34−/HLA-DR− but usually lacks bilobed hypergranular promyelocytes and is PML::RARA-negative with NPM1 mutation by molecular testing.

ddx.dx: APL with variant RARA translocation (e.g., ZBTB16::RARA)
ddx.vs: Variant RARA fusions show RARA break-apart positivity by FISH and ZBTB16::RARA cells tend to have regular nuclei and are ATRA-resistant, whereas this case had a cryptic PML::RARA insertion.

ddx.dx: Reactive promyelocyte-rich marrow (G-CSF effect or recovery)
ddx.vs: Recovering marrow shows orderly maturation with normal promyelocytes having round nuclei and a perinuclear hof, and lacks a monotonous CD34−/HLA-DR− SSC-high population.
AML with maturation shows CD34+/HLA-DR+ agranular or lightly granular blasts with maturing granulocytes rather than a dominant hypergranular bilobed promyelocyte population.

64773.stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E, MPO, IHC: MPO; flow cytometry

64645.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現一顆漿細胞：核圓而偏於一側、染色質粗顆粒，細胞質豐富深藍並有明顯核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof），背景紅血球有數顆堆疊的輕度錢串狀排列，符合骨髓瘤病人血中的循環漿細胞。
features: Single plasma cell, about 2 times the size of a red cell
Round, eccentric nucleus with coarse clumped chromatin; no conspicuous nucleolus
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent perinuclear hof and fine cytoplasmic vacuolation
Background red cells with short stacks of 2-4 cells suggesting mild rouleaux formation
Scattered normal-appearing platelets
64645.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating plasma cell with an eccentric round nucleus, coarse clumped chromatin, and abundant deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm with a distinct perinuclear hof. Background red cells show short stacks suggestive of mild rouleaux formation, and platelets are unremarkable. A single circulating plasma cell does not by itself establish plasma cell leukemia; the absolute and percentage count of circulating plasma cells (≥5% defines plasma cell leukemia per current criteria) should be determined. In a patient with known multiple myeloma, findings are consistent with circulating neoplastic plasma cells.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasmacytoid lymphocytes are part of a heterogeneous reactive lymphocytosis with less distinct hofs, and they are polytypic on flow cytometry.
LPL shows circulating small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, rather than a mature plasma cell in a myeloma patient.
Morphology is identical; plasma cell leukemia requires ≥5% circulating clonal plasma cells on the differential count.
Basophilic normoblasts have a central round nucleus with dense chromatin and uniformly blue cytoplasm without a perinuclear hof.

64325.recognize_zh: 組織球細胞質內塞滿許多大小一致（約 2–4 µm）的卵圓形小酵母菌，每顆有偏心的深染核點與周圍透明暈（halo），視野中也有少數游離在細胞外，符合播散性組織胞漿菌症（Histoplasma capsulatum）。
features: Macrophages with cytoplasm packed by numerous small, uniform oval yeast forms (about 2-4 um)
Each yeast shows a crescent-shaped or eccentric dark-staining nucleus with a surrounding clear halo (retraction artifact, not a true capsule)
Occasional extracellular yeasts among red cells
Background marrow-type cells including granulocytic and erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
Suboptimal quick stain with brownish cast and thick areas limit fine detail
64325.describe_en: Rapid-stained bedside smear (marrow-type cellularity) shows macrophages containing numerous small, uniform, oval intracellular yeasts with eccentric dark-staining nuclear material and a clear surrounding halo; a few extracellular organisms are present among red cells. Budding is not clearly resolved and definite hemophagocytosis is not evident in this field. Background hematopoietic cells are present. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis; confirmation by GMS/PAS stain, culture, and Histoplasma antigen testing is recommended, and HLH criteria should be evaluated clinically.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have both a nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack a clear halo, whereas Histoplasma yeasts have a single crescent nucleus with a halo and no kinetoplast.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and include elongated sausage-shaped forms rather than narrow-based budding.
Candida is often larger, lacks a halo and may form pseudohyphae; culture or fungal stains help distinguish.

ddx.dx: Toxoplasma tachyzoites / platelet or granule debris
ddx.vs: Toxoplasma forms are crescentic without a halo and debris lacks uniform size, internal nuclear dot and halo.

64389.recognize_zh: 一群異常細胞，核凹折或分葉，部分細胞質可見細小粉紅至紅紫色顆粒，但沒有典型 APL 那種密集粗大顆粒，符合微顆粒型 APL（M3v）。
features: Cluster of about six medium to large abnormal cells
Irregular, indented to bilobed nuclei with fine chromatin
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm; several cells show fine, dust-like pink azurophilic granules
Granules sparse and fine rather than coarse and nucleus-obscuring
No definite Auer rod bundles identified
Background red cells without notable schistocytes; platelets scant
64389.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of abnormal medium to large cells with moderate pale blue cytoplasm. Nuclei are irregular with folded or bilobed contours and finely dispersed chromatin. A subset of cells contains fine, dust-like azurophilic granules, while others appear nearly agranular; coarse granules and faggot cells are not seen. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypogranular (microgranular) variant, which requires emergent confirmation of PML::RARA and assessment for coagulopathy.

ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts can have folded nuclei and fine granules, but they are nonspecific esterase positive with CD14/CD64 and HLA-DR expression, whereas APL-v is strongly MPO positive, HLA-DR negative, and PML::RARA positive.
Normal promyelocytes have round eccentric nuclei with a paranuclear hof and nucleoli, not the bilobed butterfly-shaped nuclei of APL-v cells.
Reactive left shift shows a spectrum of maturation with myelocytes and band forms rather than a monomorphous population of immature cells with bilobed nuclei.

64133.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中骨小樑明顯增厚、不規則並彼此連接成網狀（osteosclerosis），骨髓腔被纖維性、梭形細胞為主的基質取代，造血細胞稀少，符合原發性骨髓纖維化晚期的骨硬化。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular bony trabeculae forming an interconnecting meshwork (osteosclerosis)
Irregular, broad-based bone with appositional new bone formation and scattered osteocytes
Intertrabecular spaces largely replaced by fibrous stroma with spindle cells in streaming fascicles
Marked reduction of recognizable hematopoietic cells and fat
Low-power H&E view; megakaryocyte morphology not assessable at this magnification
64133.describe_en: Low-power view of an H&E-stained bone marrow trephine biopsy shows markedly thickened and irregular bony trabeculae that branch and interconnect to form a dense meshwork, occupying a large portion of the core. The narrowed intertrabecular spaces are filled by fibrous stroma with spindled cells arranged in streaming fascicles, with markedly reduced hematopoietic elements and fat. Findings are consistent with osteomyelosclerosis, compatible with the overt fibrotic stage of primary myelofibrosis in the setting of pancytopenia and massive splenomegaly; trichrome and reticulin stains help grade collagen fibrosis.

ddx.vs: Osteoblastic metastases also cause new bone and fibrosis but contain cohesive epithelial nests that are cytokeratin positive.
Hyperparathyroid bone disease shows peritrabecular fibrosis with numerous osteoclasts and dissecting resorption (tunneling) rather than interconnecting sclerotic bone without osteoclast excess.
Paget disease shows mosaic cement lines with numerous large osteoclasts and osteoblastic rimming in a vascular fibrous marrow, without atypical megakaryocytes.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia or systemic mastocytosis with fibrosis
ddx.vs: HCL shows a fried-egg lymphoid infiltrate (CD20/annexin A1+), and mastocytosis shows spindled CD117/tryptase-positive mast cell aggregates, while both lack a diffuse sclerotic bone meshwork.

64069.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見多個兩端尖細、呈新月或鐮刀狀的紅血球（紅色箭頭），與正常圓盤狀紅血球（藍色箭頭）對比，另有標靶細胞（target cell）與一顆分葉核嗜中性球（黃色箭頭），符合鐮刀型紅血球貧血。
features: Several elongated, crescent-shaped sickle cells (drepanocytes) with pointed ends (red arrow and others)
Scattered target cells (codocytes) and occasional oval/boat-shaped forms
Normal biconcave red cell with central pallor for comparison (blue arrow)
Occasional red cell with a small dark inclusion suggestive of a Howell-Jolly body (functional asplenia)
Segmented neutrophil (yellow arrow); smudged/crushed cell at left and small platelet clumps
64069.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with numerous irreversibly sickled cells characterized by elongated, crescent shapes with pointed ends, along with target cells and occasional boat-shaped cells. A normal discocyte is labeled for comparison, and a small inclusion suggestive of a Howell-Jolly body is noted, consistent with functional asplenia. A segmented neutrophil and a smudged cell are present, and platelets are seen in small clumps. Findings are consistent with sickle cell disease; hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC is required to distinguish HbSS from compound heterozygous states.

ddx.vs: HbSC shows fewer classic sickles and more target cells with blunt, crystal-containing 'folded' or 'Washington monument' cells, confirmed by electrophoresis.
Sickle trait does not show sickled cells on routine smears under normal oxygenation, and HbS is less than 50% on electrophoresis.
Elliptocytes are oval with rounded blunt ends and uniform shape rather than crescent-shaped cells with pointed ends.
Sickle beta-thalassemia shows sickle cells with prominent microcytosis and hypochromia and requires HPLC with HbA2 quantitation for distinction.

64005.recognize_zh: 視野中多顆紅血球邊緣有半圓形缺口（bite cell）或一側透明泡狀區（blister cell），左上角嗜中性球胞質顆粒偏粗、偏深（toxic granulation），符合藥物引起的氧化性溶血合併發炎反應。
features: Multiple bite cells with smooth semicircular defects in the red cell margin
Occasional blister cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side and a pale peripheral zone
Scattered crenated red cells (echinocytes) and mild anisocytosis
Segmented neutrophil with increased, coarse, darker cytoplasmic granules consistent with toxic granulation
Platelets present; background stain precipitate
64005.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Leishman stain, high power) shows red cell poikilocytosis with numerous bite cells bearing smooth semicircular marginal defects, occasional blister cells with hemoglobin displaced to one side, and scattered crenated cells. A segmented neutrophil displays coarse, dark cytoplasmic granules consistent with toxic granulation. Spherocytes and schistocytes are not prominent, and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with oxidative hemolysis, compatible with the clinical history of drug-induced hemolytic anemia.

ddx.dx: G6PD deficiency with acute hemolytic episode
ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable, so a G6PD enzyme assay (ideally repeated after reticulocytosis settles) is needed.
Immune-mediated hemolysis shows spherocytes and polychromasia with a positive direct antiglobulin test rather than bite and blister cells.
MAHA shows helmet cells, triangular fragments and thrombocytopenia, rather than intact cells with single rounded bites.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil with normal granulation or Alder-Reilly anomaly
ddx.vs: Toxic granulation accompanies left shift, Döhle bodies or vacuoles in infection or stress, whereas Alder-Reilly granules are inherited, uniformly dense, and also seen in lymphocytes and monocytes.

60549.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成群聚集的小至中型圓形細胞，核圓或卵圓、染色質細緻呈點狀、細胞質極少，細胞之間有淡紫藍色、扭曲纏繞的纖維狀物（神經纖維網，neuropil），這種「小圓藍細胞群＋纖維網」是神經母細胞瘤骨髓轉移的特徵。
features: Loose cohesive clusters of small to medium round cells with very high N:C ratio (10 um scale bar)
Round to oval nuclei with finely stippled (salt-and-pepper) chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli; some nuclear molding
Scant, barely visible cytoplasm
Fibrillary pale purple-blue neuropil threads twisting between and extending from the tumor cells
Crushed, elongated smeared nuclei along the fibrillary strands; background red cells and a small blue-staining particle
60549.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of small to medium round tumor cells that are foreign to the marrow, distributed among red cells. The cells have round to oval nuclei with finely stippled chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, occasional nuclear molding and scant cytoplasm. Characteristic fibrillary, twisted neuropil threads extend between the cells, with admixed crushed and elongated nuclei. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma involving the marrow, confirmable with PHOX2B, synaptophysin or chromogranin immunostains and urine catecholamine metabolites.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are dispersed singly without cohesive clusters, nuclear molding or fibrillary neuropil, and they express TdT/CD34 rather than neural markers.
Ewing cells form clusters with PAS-positive vacuolated cytoplasm but no neuropil, and are CD99 positive with EWSR1 rearrangement.
Rhabdomyoblasts have more cytoplasm, multinucleation and vacuoles without neuropil and are desmin/myogenin positive with FOXO1 fusion.
These may show Homer Wright rosettes but occur with a known CNS or ocular primary and lack elevated urinary catecholamines and PHOX2B expression.

63877.recognize_zh: A 流式細胞圖中 CD3−CD5− 的異常淋巴族群呈 CD2＋、CD7＋（偏弱）、CD8＋、CD4−、CD56 強陽性、CD25−，符合 NK 細胞表型；B 圖骨髓切片被中至大型異型淋巴細胞大量取代，C 圖腫瘤細胞核呈強而廣泛的 p53 陽性。
features: Flow (A): CD45-bright, low side scatter lymphoid population (green) that is CD3-/CD5-, CD2+, CD7+ (dim), CD8+, CD4-, CD56 bright and CD25-
H&E (B): hypercellular marrow largely replaced by medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio and irregular hyperchromatic nuclei
Scattered residual erythroid and granulocytic elements and fat in B
p53 IHC (C): strong diffuse nuclear staining in a large proportion of the neoplastic cells
63877.describe_en: Flow cytometry (A) identifies an abnormal CD45-positive lymphoid population with low side scatter that lacks CD3 and CD5 and expresses CD2, dim CD7, CD8 and bright CD56, without CD4 or CD25. The bone marrow core biopsy (B) is hypercellular and largely replaced by a diffuse infiltrate of medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratios and irregular nuclei among residual hematopoietic elements. Immunohistochemistry for p53 (C) shows strong, diffuse nuclear staining in most neoplastic cells, suggesting TP53 alteration. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by an NK-cell lymphoma/leukemia with aberrant p53 expression; EBER in situ hybridization and TP53 sequencing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Shares the NK phenotype; it is defined clinically by systemic leukemic presentation and usually EBV positivity, whereas this patient has known extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma with marrow relapse.
HSTCL shows a sinusoidal marrow pattern and expresses surface CD3 with gamma-delta TCR, unlike this sCD3-negative, TCR-negative infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: Indolent NK proliferations consist of small granular lymphocytes with low-level marrow involvement and no p53 overexpression, not effacement by large atypical cells.
BPDCN is CD4+/CD56+ with CD123 and TCL1 positivity and lacks CD2/CD8 expression.

63749.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍（A）骨小樑間的髓腔被瀰漫性小細胞浸潤取代、脂肪幾乎消失；高倍（B）為小淋巴球與漿細胞樣細胞混合，箭頭處可見核內淡粉紅色、圓形的 Dutcher 小體（核內免疫球蛋白偽包涵體），是淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤的重要線索。
features: Hypercellular marrow with diffuse, near-total replacement of intertrabecular space (low power, A)
Infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with clock-face chromatin
Dutcher bodies: pale eosinophilic round intranuclear pseudo-inclusions (arrows, B)
Mild nuclear variation without large transformed cells or sheets of blasts
Scattered eosinophilic cytoplasm of plasma cells; few residual hematopoietic elements
63749.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with diffuse replacement of the intertrabecular spaces by a small-cell infiltrate (A). At high power (B), the infiltrate is composed of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells, with readily identified Dutcher bodies appearing as round, pale eosinophilic intranuclear pseudo-inclusions. Large transformed cells are not prominent. Findings are consistent with involvement by a B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, favoring lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, pending immunophenotyping and MYD88 L265P testing.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL can show identical plasmacytic differentiation and Dutcher bodies; separation relies on clinical sites (splenic/nodal/extranodal), paratrabecular vs sinusoidal pattern and absence of MYD88 L265P in most MZL.
Myeloma consists of clonal plasma cells alone (CD19-/CD20-, often CD56+) without a clonal CD20+ small B-cell component.
CLL/SLL infiltrates are CD5+/CD23+ small lymphocytes with proliferation centers and lack prominent plasmacytic differentiation.
MCL shows monotonous small cleaved cells that are cyclin D1/SOX11 positive without plasma cells or Dutcher bodies.

63685.recognize_zh: 一群大型細胞，細胞核呈細緻摺疊、凹陷或腦迴狀（delicately folded / convoluted），染色質細緻、核仁不明顯，細胞質中等量、灰藍色帶細顆粒，這是單核芽細胞等價的前單核球（promonocytes）。
features: Large cells with moderate N:C ratio arranged in a loose cluster
Irregular, delicately folded, indented or lobulated (convoluted) nuclei
Fine, lacy chromatin with small pale patches; nucleoli small and indistinct
Moderate pale gray-blue cytoplasm with very fine, sparse granules
Occasional cells with a more rounded nucleus resembling monoblasts; no Auer rods seen
Background of lysed/smeared material suggests a marrow aspirate preparation
63685.describe_en: The smear shows a cluster of large mononuclear cells with moderate amounts of pale gray-blue, finely granular cytoplasm. The nuclei are irregular with delicate folds, indentations and lobulation, fine lacy chromatin, and small indistinct nucleoli. No Auer rods, coarse granules or cytoplasmic vacuoles are evident, and mature monocytes with condensed chromatin are not seen in this field. These cells represent promonocytes, which are counted as blast equivalents; when they and monoblasts reach 20% or more, findings are consistent with acute monocytic or myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Mature monocytes have more condensed, clumped chromatin, abundant gray cytoplasm with vacuoles, and are not counted as blast equivalents, whereas promonocytes retain fine chromatin.
Microgranular APL cells have bilobed sliding-plate nuclei with strong MPO positivity and PML::RARA, while promonocytes are nonspecific esterase positive and MPO weak or negative.
Monoblasts are larger with round nuclei, one or more prominent nucleoli and more abundant basophilic cytoplasm, lacking the nuclear folding of promonocytes.
Sézary cells have cerebriform nuclei with hyperchromatic chromatin and scant cytoplasm, and are CD4+ T cells on flow cytometry.

63621.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中央有一個大型、邊界清楚的結節，由淡粉紅色細胞質、長橢圓形核的類上皮組織球（epithelioid histiocytes）緊密聚集，外圍有淋巴球環繞，中央無壞死，符合非壞死性肉芽腫（non-necrotizing granuloma）。
features: Large, well-circumscribed granuloma composed of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and elongated, oval to reniform nuclei
Rim of small lymphocytes at the periphery of the granuloma
No central necrosis
Possible small multinucleated cell near the lower edge (resolution limited)
Surrounding cellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and fat spaces
63621.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a large, well-circumscribed granuloma composed of tightly clustered epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and elongated vesicular nuclei, rimmed by small lymphocytes. There is no central necrosis. A possible multinucleated cell is present at the lower edge, and the surrounding marrow is cellular with trilineage hematopoiesis. Findings are consistent with a non-necrotizing epithelioid granuloma; in the clinical context of sarcoidosis this is supportive, after exclusion of infection with AFB and fungal stains and cultures.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas frequently have caseous necrosis and AFB-positive bacilli, which must be excluded with stains and culture.
Fungal granulomas can contain yeast forms highlighted by GMS or PAS stains.
Hodgkin involvement shows CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background, often with fibrosis.
Drug-related granulomas are morphologically similar and are separated by medication history rather than histology.

63557.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片在造血細胞之間散布大量大小不一、均質亮粉紅色的圓形球體，有些成群聚在細胞內（Mott cell），有些單獨游離於間質，這是免疫球蛋白堆積（Russell bodies／細胞外沉積）的低倍表現。
features: Numerous round, homogeneous, glassy eosinophilic globules of variable size scattered throughout the interstitium
Some globules clustered in groups within single cells (Mott cells); others appear as large solitary extracellular globules
Cellular marrow between fat spaces with mixed hematopoietic cells; individual plasma cells are difficult to resolve at this magnification
Scattered cells with eccentric nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm consistent with plasma cells
Intact bony trabeculae at the edges without obvious osteolytic remodeling in this field
63557.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine section at medium power shows normocellular to mildly hypercellular marrow between adipocytes, containing numerous round, homogeneous, brightly eosinophilic globules of varying size. Globules are seen both clustered within cells, consistent with Mott cells, and as larger solitary extracellular deposits of immunoglobulin. Plasma cells with eccentric nuclei are present in the interstitium, but their number and clonality cannot be reliably assessed at this magnification. Bone trabeculae appear intact. Findings indicate plasma cells with prominent Russell body formation and extracellular immunoglobulin deposition; CD138 and kappa/lambda immunohistochemistry are needed to quantify plasma cells and assess clonality.

ddx.vs: Red cells are small, uniform biconcave discs of about 7 micrometers, whereas these globules vary greatly in size and many exceed red cell diameter.
Amyloid forms amorphous, pale, waxy perivascular or interstitial deposits rather than discrete spherical globules and is Congo red positive with apple-green birefringence.
Gelatinous transformation shows pale, faintly basophilic amorphous extracellular material with fat atrophy and hypocellularity, not dense eosinophilic spheres.

63493.recognize_zh: 這是骨髓切片的免疫組織化學染色：藍色核染的小至中型圓形細胞片狀排列，其中一部分細胞呈棕色顆粒狀細胞質／膜染色，陽性與陰性細胞混雜；標記名稱未標示，需對照原病例。
features: Sheets of small to intermediate round cells with hematoxylin-counterstained nuclei
Heterogeneous brown granular cytoplasmic/membranous staining in a subset of cells
Positive cells are scattered and patchy rather than uniform across the population
Loosely cohesive, partly disrupted tissue with empty spaces
Marker not identified in the image; no nuclear-pattern staining evident
63493.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a bone marrow biopsy shows a dense population of small to intermediate round cells. A subset of cells shows granular cytoplasmic/membranous brown staining in a patchy distribution, while many cells are negative. The specific antibody is not indicated, so the lineage significance of this pattern cannot be determined from the image alone. In the provided context of acute leukemia with focal coagulative necrosis, this stain is part of the immunophenotypic workup and must be interpreted with the full IHC panel and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Blasts would be expected to be positive for CD19/CD79a/PAX5 and TdT/CD34 with a nuclear TdT pattern, which cannot be confirmed without knowing the marker used here.
Myeloblasts would show MPO/CD33/CD117 positivity and lack B-lineage markers, requiring a lineage-specific panel to separate.

ddx.dx: Reactive/residual myeloid cells highlighted by the stain
ddx.vs: Patchy granular cytoplasmic positivity in a minority of cells may represent residual normal granulocytes (e.g., with MPO/lysozyme) rather than the neoplastic population.

63301.recognize_zh: CD4/CD8 散佈圖中，異常族群（藍色）落在 CD4 陽性、CD8 陰性的位置，與正常 CD4 T 細胞（紅色）重疊，CD8 T 細胞（綠色）則位於右側；結合前面 sCD3−CD5+CD7− 的表現，可認出淋巴球型 HES 的 CD3−CD4+ 異常 T 細胞。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot: CD8-ECD (x-axis) versus CD4-APC750 (y-axis), panel D
Aberrant population (blue) is CD4-positive and CD8-negative, overlapping with normal CD4+ T cells (red)
Discrete CD8-positive, CD4-negative T cells (green)
Orange events with dim CD4 and variable CD8 (likely NK cells/other)
Purple CD4-negative, CD8-negative events near the origin (B cells)
63301.describe_en: Flow cytometric plot of CD8 versus CD4 shows that the aberrant population (blue) is CD4-positive and CD8-negative, overlapping the normal CD4+ T-cell compartment (red); normal CD8+ T cells (green) and double-negative lymphocytes (purple) are also seen. CD4/CD8 alone does not identify the abnormality, which is defined by the loss of surface CD3 and CD7 on these CD4+ cells in the companion plots. Findings are consistent with a CD3-CD4+ aberrant T-cell population of the lymphocytic variant of hypereosinophilic syndrome.

ddx.vs: Also a CD4+CD8- population with CD7 loss, but typically retains surface CD3 and presents with erythroderma and cerebriform lymphocytes.
ATLL is CD4+CD25 bright with frequent CD7 loss, HTLV-1 serology and flower cells, which are not features of lymphocytic HES.
A normal elevated CD4:CD8 ratio lacks a population with aberrant surface CD3 or CD7 loss, which must be confirmed on the other tubes.

63237.recognize_zh: 病灶大部分被寬大、互相吻合的嗜伊紅性玻璃樣小樑取代，小樑之間夾著小淋巴球與漿細胞；這些小樑可能是化骨／類骨質，但此圖看不到明確的骨小腔、造骨細胞邊緣或黏合線，也可能是玻璃樣化膠原，需高倍確認。
features: Broad, anastomosing, eosinophilic homogeneous trabeculae occupying much of the field
Trabeculae contain few cells; definite osteocytic lacunae, osteoblastic rimming or cement lines are not clearly resolved
Intervening spaces filled by small lymphocytes with admixed plasma cells and thin-walled vessels
Focal hemorrhage (lower center)
No lymphoid follicles in this field
63237.describe_en: Section shows a lesion extensively replaced by broad, anastomosing, eosinophilic trabeculae with intervening small lymphocytes, plasma cells and thin-walled vessels, and a focus of hemorrhage. The trabecular material is consistent with metaplastic ossification or osteoid, as described, but osteocytic lacunae, osteoblastic rimming and cement lines are not clearly evident at this magnification, so dense hyalinized collagen cannot be excluded from this image alone. No lymphoid follicles are present in this field. Findings are compatible with regressive stromal change (ossification/hyalinization) in long-standing Castleman disease, correlating with other fields showing regressed follicles.

ddx.vs: Hyalinized collagen lacks osteocytes in lacunae, osteoblast rimming and cement lines, which would need higher power or polarization to separate from bone.
Amyloid forms amorphous pale eosinophilic deposits, often perivascular, that are Congo red-positive with apple-green birefringence rather than trabecular bone.
Would contain atypical malignant cells producing osteoid, whereas the cells between trabeculae here are bland small lymphocytes and plasma cells.

63173.recognize_zh: 中央一顆白血球被約二十個血小板緊密環繞（platelet satellitism），而背景中游離血小板很少，這種貼附在白血球周圍的血小板會被血球計數儀漏算，造成偽血小板低下。
features: Central leukocyte encircled by approximately 20 adherent platelets
Platelets are small, granular and closely apposed to the leukocyte membrane
Second leukocyte (lymphoid-appearing) with only a single adjacent platelet
Few free platelets in the background apart from small scattered clusters
Thick area of smear with overlapping red cells, limiting leukocyte subtyping
63173.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a leukocyte surrounded by a ring of approximately 20 adherent platelets, consistent with platelet satellitism. A second leukocyte shows only a single adjacent platelet, and free platelets in the background are relatively sparse with a few small aggregates. The field is from a thick area of the smear with overlapping red cells, which limits precise leukocyte identification. Findings are consistent with pseudothrombocytopenia due to EDTA-induced platelet satellitism; a repeat platelet count in a citrate or heparin tube is recommended.

ddx.vs: True thrombocytopenia shows uniformly few platelets without satellitism or clumps, and the low count persists in non-EDTA anticoagulants.
Clumping produces free platelet aggregates, often at the feathered edge, rather than rings of platelets around leukocytes.
Inherited macrothrombocytopenia shows large single platelets approaching red cell size that are undercounted, not normal-sized platelets adherent to leukocytes.

63109.recognize_zh: ERG 在沿血管腔排列的內襯細胞核呈強陽性，而周圍淋巴球與間質細胞核為陰性（藍色）；清楚標示病灶的血管腔是由內皮系細胞構成。
features: Strong nuclear ERG staining in cells lining vascular channels
Positive nuclei aligned in a single layer along channel walls and in small capillaries
Lining cell nuclei ovoid, some plump
Intervening lymphoid and stromal cells ERG-negative
Red cells and proteinaceous material in lumens
63109.describe_en: ERG immunostain shows strong nuclear staining in the cells lining the vascular channels and small capillaries of the splenic lesion, with negative intervening lymphoid and stromal cells. The lining cells form a single layer without solid clusters. The findings confirm endothelial differentiation of the lining cells, supporting a vascular lesion such as littoral cell angioma when interpreted with histiocytic marker coexpression.

ddx.vs: Both are ERG-positive; hemangioma lacks CD68/CD163/CD21 and is CD34-positive.
Angiosarcoma is also ERG-positive but shows multilayering, atypia, solid areas and high proliferation.
Carcinoma cells are cytokeratin-positive and ERG-negative (except prostate), forming cohesive nests rather than a single lining layer.

63045.recognize_zh: 中倍鏡下骨小樑增厚、輪廓不規則且邊緣呈扇貝狀凹陷，彼此吻合成網；骨髓腔被含小血管的疏鬆纖維血管性組織取代，幾乎不見造血細胞，符合 Paget 骨病。
features: Thickened, irregular, anastomosing bony trabeculae with scalloped (resorption bay) contours
Osteocytes in lacunae within the trabeculae; faint irregular lamellar pattern
Marrow spaces filled with loose, edematous fibrovascular connective tissue containing numerous small vessels
Near absence of hematopoietic cells in the marrow spaces
No infiltrate of tumor cells or granulomas identified
63045.describe_en: Section of bone marrow trephine at intermediate power shows increased bone with thickened, irregular, anastomosing trabeculae displaying scalloped resorption contours. The intertrabecular spaces are replaced by loose, edematous fibrovascular connective tissue with numerous small vessels, and hematopoietic elements are nearly absent. No metastatic tumor or granulomas are seen. Findings are consistent with Paget disease of bone in the appropriate radiologic and biochemical context.

ddx.vs: Metastases show keratin-positive epithelial nests within desmoplastic stroma, absent here.
Hyperparathyroidism shows dissecting tunneling resorption with peritrabecular fibrosis and abnormal PTH/calcium, without a mosaic cement-line pattern.
Fibrous dysplasia has curvilinear woven-bone 'Chinese character' trabeculae without osteoblastic rimming in a cellular fibrous stroma, rather than thick lamellar trabeculae with resorption bays.

62981.recognize_zh: CT 可見視丘占位病灶（箭頭），切片為成片的大型漿母細胞樣/免疫母細胞樣淋巴瘤細胞，核偏位、核仁明顯、細胞質豐富；免疫染色 B 細胞標記陰性、多個核染色陽性且 Ki-67 極高，符合腔外型原發性滲出性淋巴瘤（extracavitary PEL）。
features: CT (A): mass lesion in the thalamus/deep gray matter (arrowhead) with surrounding hypodensity
H&E low power (B): diffuse sheets of discohesive lymphoid cells in brain parenchyma
H&E high power (C): large cells with round, eccentric nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate to abundant amphophilic cytoplasm (plasmablastic/immunoblastic)
IHC (D, H): largely negative or only focal/membranous staining in tumor cells
Nuclear stains (E, F, G) diffusely positive in tumor cells; chromogenic ISH (I, red) positive in many nuclei
Proliferation stain (J): very high nuclear positivity
62981.describe_en: Composite figure. Axial CT shows a thalamic mass lesion. Biopsy shows brain parenchyma diffusely infiltrated by sheets of large discohesive cells with eccentric round nuclei, prominent nucleoli and abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, imparting a plasmablastic/immunoblastic appearance. The immunostain panel shows negative or weak staining with some markers, diffuse nuclear positivity with several nuclear markers, positive red-chromogen in situ hybridization in many nuclei, and a very high proliferation index. The individual markers are not labeled in the image; in the clinical context the findings are consistent with extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma (HHV8-positive, frequently EBV-positive) presenting as a thalamic mass.

ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma is morphologically similar and EBER+ but HHV8/LANA-negative, whereas PEL is HHV8/LANA-positive.

ddx.dx: Primary CNS diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: PCNSL is angiocentric and expresses CD20/PAX5 with an ABC phenotype, and is HHV8-negative.
Myeloma shows light-chain-restricted cytoplasmic immunoglobulin and CD138/CD56, and is HHV8- and EBV-negative.
HHV8+ DLBCL usually arises with multicentric Castleman disease, expresses IgM lambda and is EBV-negative, unlike typically EBV+ immunoglobulin-null PEL.

62981.stain: CT; H&E; IHC panel; ISH (red chromogen)

62917.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸片中可見成群中至大型、高核質比、染色質細緻的母細胞（blasts），其間夾雜數個細胞核偏位、細胞質嗜鹼性的漿細胞；母細胞系別無法單憑型態判定，需靠流式（cCD3、TdT）確認為 T 淋巴母細胞。
features: Cohesive-appearing clusters of intermediate to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous to small
Scant to moderate agranular basophilic cytoplasm; several larger cells show fine punctate clear vacuoles
Scattered plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei and more abundant blue cytoplasm
Occasional small mature lymphocytes and ruptured/smudged cells
Background of lysed red cells and debris
62917.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of immature mononuclear cells admixed with scattered plasma cells in a background of lysed red cells and debris. The blasts are intermediate to large with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm, some with fine vacuoles; no Auer rods are seen. Interspersed cells with eccentric nuclei and abundant basophilic cytoplasm are consistent with plasma cells. Lineage cannot be assigned morphologically; in conjunction with the flow cytometric findings (cCD3+, CD5+, TdT+, MPO-), findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia with reactive plasmacytosis.

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable; B-ALL expresses CD19, CD79a, and CD10/cyCD22 rather than cytoplasmic CD3.
Blasts may also be agranular, but are MPO or myeloid-marker positive by flow and lack cytoplasmic CD3.
Plasma cells there are clonal (light-chain restricted, often CD56+/CD117+) with an M-protein, whereas here they are polyclonal and accompany a TdT+ blast population.

62853.recognize_zh: 一顆大型異型細胞，深藍色細胞質內有細小空泡，細胞內可見已凝縮成條狀的染色體（有絲分裂中期樣）與旁邊另一團未分裂的核質，呈現核分裂不完全的異常分裂（endomitosis），圖中未能清楚辨認 Russell 小體。
features: Very large atypical cell with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing fine clear vacuoles
Condensed rod-like chromosomes in a metaphase-like arrangement occupying part of the cell
Separate eccentric nuclear mass with finely granular chromatin in the same cytoplasm (abnormal/incomplete division)
Plasma-cell-type basophilia; discrete Russell bodies not clearly identifiable in this image
Surrounding small lymphocytes, erythroid precursors and red cells
62853.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a very large atypical cell with abundant, deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm. Within the cell there is a cluster of condensed, rod-like chromosomes in a metaphase-like configuration alongside a separate eccentric nuclear mass, indicating an abnormal mitosis with chromosome condensation not followed by normal nuclear division (endomitosis). The cytoplasmic basophilia supports plasmacytic differentiation, although discrete Russell bodies are not clearly seen in this field. In a patient with CLL, findings are consistent with a highly proliferative atypical plasmablastic cell, supporting Richter transformation to plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have granular pinkish cytoplasm and form a single lobulated polyploid nucleus rather than basophilic vacuolated plasmacytoid cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with anaplastic/multinucleated cells
ddx.vs: Morphology may overlap; distinction relies on clinical features (M-protein, CRAB), CD20/PAX5 loss, EBER status and history of CLL.
Carcinoma cells tend to occur in cohesive clusters and are cytokeratin-positive, lacking CD138/MUM1 expression.

62789.recognize_zh: 組織中的母細胞呈巢狀、聚集在血管或竇狀空間內，看起來像血管內大B細胞淋巴瘤；但細胞中等大小、染色質細緻，核染色免疫標記呈瀰漫強陽性，骨髓切片亦被母細胞取代，支持前驅B淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Cohesive-appearing nests and cords of medium-sized blasts confined within vascular/sinusoidal spaces separated by pale stroma (A)
Blasts with high N:C ratio, round nuclei and fine chromatin
Diffuse strong nuclear immunostaining of the intravascular blast aggregates (B; marker not labeled)
Patchy membranous/cytoplasmic immunostaining in a subset of blasts (C; marker not labeled)
Bone marrow biopsy with sheets of blasts replacing normal hematopoiesis adjacent to bony trabecula (D)
62789.describe_en: Tissue sections show medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and fine chromatin distributed as nests and cords within vascular or sinusoidal spaces, creating an intravascular growth pattern. The blasts show diffuse strong nuclear immunoreactivity and patchy membranous/cytoplasmic staining for a second marker (antibodies not labeled in the figure). The bone marrow biopsy is diffusely replaced by similar blasts. The cell size and chromatin favor lymphoblasts over large B cells; in conjunction with immunophenotype, findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with an intravascular pattern mimicking intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: IVLBCL cells are large with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and are TdT/CD34 negative, whereas lymphoblasts are medium-sized with fine chromatin and express TdT.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with intravascular spread
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts express MPO, CD117 and CD33 and lack PAX5/CD19/CD79a.

ddx.dx: Small round blue cell tumors (e.g., neuroblastoma, Ewing sarcoma)
ddx.vs: These tumors form rosettes or nests, lack CD45/TdT/PAX5 and express neural or CD99/NKX2.2 markers.

62725.recognize_zh: 10倍低倍下整張抹片布滿藍紫色有核細胞，顯示白血球極度增多（hyperleukocytosis），箭頭處為紅血球成團聚集；低倍只能判斷細胞量與紅血球凝集，細胞型態需高倍確認。
features: Low-power view with markedly increased density of nucleated cells (hyperleukocytosis)
Nucleated cells appear relatively uniform in size at this magnification
Discrete clumps of agglutinated red cells (black arrows)
Background red cells otherwise dispersed
Magnification insufficient to assess nuclear shape, granules or Auer rods
62725.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a markedly increased number of nucleated cells, consistent with hyperleukocytosis, with several discrete clumps of agglutinated red cells (arrows). Cytologic detail of the nucleated cells, including nuclear shape, granularity and Auer rods, cannot be evaluated at this magnification. In conjunction with higher-power images showing bilobed hypogranular promyelocytes, findings are consistent with microgranular acute promyelocytic leukemia with hyperleukocytosis and red cell agglutination.

ddx.vs: CML shows a full spectrum of maturing granulocytes with basophilia and myelocyte bulge at higher power rather than a uniform population of abnormal promyelocytes.
Lymphoblasts are smaller with scant agranular cytoplasm and MPO negativity, which requires higher-power and ancillary evaluation.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-agglutination due to thick smear or rouleaux
ddx.vs: Rouleaux form linear stacks in thick areas, whereas true agglutinates are irregular clumps in thin areas of the smear.

62661.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結被膜與周圍脂肪完整，實質內有數個濾泡；被膜下竇與中間竇內可見淡染、較大的細胞群聚，與深藍色的小淋巴球區形成對比，提示腫瘤沿淋巴竇浸潤。
features: Lymph node with fibrous capsule and perinodal adipose tissue
Several follicles with germinal centers in the cortex
Paler clusters of larger cells within subcapsular and intermediate sinuses
Sinusoidal distribution of the pale cell clusters between darker lymphoid areas
Small lymphoid aggregate within the capsule/perinodal tissue
62661.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a lymph node shows an intact fibrous capsule with perinodal fat and several cortical follicles with germinal centers. Pale-staining clusters of larger cells are present in the subcapsular and intermediate sinuses, contrasting with the darker small-lymphocyte compartments. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Findings suggest a sinusoidal infiltrate of large cells, consistent with extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma in the context of the case.

ddx.vs: Similar sinusoidal pattern but the cells are CD30/ALK or T-cell positive and HHV8-negative.
Subcapsular sinus deposits are keratin or melanocytic marker positive and CD45/MUM1/HHV8-negative.
Sinuses are distended by bland histiocytes with low-grade nuclei rather than atypical large lymphoid cells.

62597.recognize_zh: 軸切面 PET 影像顯示前縱膈腔偏右、胸骨後方一個邊界清楚且強烈 FDG 攝取的腫塊（箭頭），代表高代謝的淋巴增生病灶，是切片取樣的目標。
features: Axial FDG-PET image at upper thoracic level (anterior at top, patient right on left)
Single intensely FDG-avid, well-circumscribed mass in the anterior/prevascular mediastinum (arrow)
Photopenic central dot artifact within the lesion
Low background uptake in lungs and chest wall; no additional avid focus on this slice
62597.describe_en: Axial FDG-PET image of the upper chest demonstrates a solitary, intensely hypermetabolic, well-circumscribed mass in the anterior mediastinum (arrow), with low background activity in the lungs and chest wall. PET cannot establish histology; intense FDG avidity indicates a metabolically active lesion and helps direct biopsy and staging. In a transplant recipient, this finding supports an extranodal/mediastinal mass-forming lesion such as post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder, confirmed here on biopsy as plasmacytoma-like PTLD, EBV+.

62533.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下，淋巴竇內充滿大型組織球，細胞質豐富、淡染而呈泡沫／空泡狀，核圓、空泡狀並有小核仁，其間夾雜小淋巴球與漿細胞，部分淋巴球似位於組織球內；配合臨床為巨大淋巴結病，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated to foamy cytoplasm
Round vesicular histiocyte nuclei with small nucleoli and bland cytology
Numerous admixed small lymphocytes and plasma cells, some apparently within histiocyte cytoplasm
Fibrous septa and denser lymphoplasmacytic areas at the right edge
No necrosis, eosinophil clusters, or atypical mitoses
62533.describe_en: Lymph node section at high power shows sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli. Many small lymphocytes and plasma cells are intermixed, and some lymphocytes appear to lie within histiocyte cytoplasm, suggesting emperipolesis. Fibrous bands and denser lymphoplasmacytic areas are present at the periphery, without necrosis or significant atypia. Findings are suggestive of Rosai-Dorfman disease, with S100 positivity and CD1a negativity needed for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Infection-associated foamy histiocytosis (e.g., mycobacterial spindle cell pseudotumor, Whipple disease)
ddx.vs: Infectious foamy histiocytes contain organisms on AFB or PAS stains and are S100-negative.
LCH cells have grooved nuclei, eosinophils are prominent, and the cells are CD1a/langerin-positive.
ECD shows foamy histiocytes with Touton giant cells and fibrosis, are S100-negative or weak, and frequently harbor BRAF V600E.

62469.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中箭頭指向兩顆大型組織球，細胞質豐富、呈淡藍綠色細顆粒狀（sea-blue histiocyte 樣），核偏位；背景充滿深染圓核的晚期紅血球母細胞，呈紅系增生，符合溶血性貧血時紅血球大量破壞後的組織球反應。
features: Two large histiocytes (arrows) with abundant pale blue-green, finely granular to foamy cytoplasm
Single round to oval, eccentric nucleus with open chromatin; adjacent erythroid precursors abut the histiocytes
No well-defined phagocytosed intact red cells within the histiocytes in this field
Background marked erythroid hyperplasia with numerous small, round, dense-nucleated polychromatophilic and orthochromatic normoblasts
Scattered myeloid precursors; cellular aspirate with red cells in the background
62469.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows marked erythroid hyperplasia, with numerous late-stage normoblasts bearing small round, dense nuclei. Scattered among the hematopoietic cells are large histiocytes (arrows) with abundant pale blue-green, finely granular cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei, resembling sea-blue histiocytes; erythroid precursors lie closely apposed to them. Distinct ingested red cells or organisms are not identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a reactive histiocytic response to increased red cell turnover in hemolytic anemia; storage disorders should be considered clinically if histiocytes are numerous.

ddx.vs: Primary lipid storage disorders show many more sea-blue or foamy histiocytes with hepatosplenomegaly and require enzyme or genetic testing, whereas secondary forms accompany high cell turnover such as hemolysis, CML, or ITP.
Gaucher cells have wrinkled 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm with a fibrillary texture rather than the fine blue-green granularity seen here.
HLH histiocytes contain engulfed intact erythrocytes, platelets, or nucleated cells, which are not clearly seen in these cells.
Megaloblastic erythroid precursors show open, sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, unlike the dense, mature normoblast nuclei here.

62405.recognize_zh: CD20 染色中黏膜固有層被大片密集的棕色陽性 B 細胞充滿，把殘存的腺體（藍色、陰性）分隔包圍，並可見少數陽性細胞侵入腺上皮；黏膜內瀰漫 B 細胞浸潤合併上皮侵犯，是黏膜相關淋巴組織淋巴瘤（MALT lymphoma）的特徵。
features: Dense, diffuse CD20-positive B-cell infiltrate expanding the lamina propria
Residual CD20-negative glands separated and surrounded by the infiltrate
Focal CD20-positive cells infiltrating glandular epithelium (lymphoepithelial lesions)
Strong membranous staining of small to intermediate lymphoid cells
Loss of normal mucosal architecture with gland dropout
62405.describe_en: CD20 immunostain of a mucosal biopsy highlights a dense, diffuse infiltrate of B cells that expands the lamina propria and separates residual glands, which are negative. Scattered CD20-positive cells extend into the glandular epithelium, consistent with lymphoepithelial lesions. The B cells are reported to co-express CD43 and BCL2. The findings are consistent with extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT lymphoma).

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphoid hyperplasia (e.g., H. pylori gastritis)
ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates contain well-formed follicles with a mixed T/B distribution, lack aberrant CD43 co-expression, and are polyclonal.
MCL cells co-express CD5 and cyclin D1/SOX11, which MALT lymphoma lacks.
FL forms neoplastic follicles expressing CD10 and BCL6 with BCL2 in germinal centers, rather than a diffuse CD10-negative marginal zone infiltrate.
DLBCL consists of sheets of large transformed B cells with a high Ki-67 rather than small centrocyte-like/monocytoid cells.

62341.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片 CD138 染色：真皮內大量大型、核偏位的腫瘤細胞呈細胞膜與顆粒狀細胞質陽性，部分為雙核或多核；左上方的表皮角質細胞也呈網狀膜陽性，是正常的內部陽性對照，不應誤認為腫瘤。
features: Dermal sheets of large discohesive cells with strong membranous and granular cytoplasmic CD138 staining
Round, often eccentric nuclei; occasional binucleated and multinucleated tumor cells
Marked variation in cell size consistent with pleomorphic plasma cells
Overlying squamous epithelium (upper left) shows chicken-wire membranous CD138 positivity as a normal internal control
Intervening stroma with CD138-negative spindle and endothelial cells
62341.describe_en: CD138 immunohistochemistry on a skin biopsy shows a dense dermal infiltrate of large, discohesive, pleomorphic cells with strong membranous and granular cytoplasmic staining, including binucleated and multinucleated forms. The overlying squamous epithelium at the upper left shows the expected intercellular membranous CD138 staining of keratinocytes, serving as an internal positive control, while stromal cells are negative. The findings support a plasma cell neoplasm involving the dermis; in a patient with known myeloma this represents cutaneous involvement by plasma cell myeloma, and light-chain restriction should be documented.

ddx.vs: Squamous carcinoma is also CD138-positive, so cytokeratin/p40 positivity and continuity with the epidermis must be excluded, whereas myeloma cells are keratin-negative, MUM1-positive and light-chain restricted.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shares a CD138+/CD20- phenotype but is typically EBER-positive in immunocompromised hosts without marrow myeloma or M-protein.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Marginal zone lymphoma contains mature small plasma cells mixed with CD20-positive B cells and reactive follicles rather than sheets of pleomorphic multinucleated CD138-positive cells.
Melanoma is S100/SOX10/Melan-A-positive and usually CD138-negative, despite similar large nucleolated discohesive cells.

62277.recognize_zh: CD57 染色在大結節內與結節間都有大量散在的小型陽性細胞，結節內密度略高，右上方小濾泡周圍可見陽性細胞環狀分布；低倍率下無法評估是否圍繞大型 LP 細胞。
features: Abundant scattered small CD57-positive cells throughout the large nodule and interfollicular areas
Somewhat higher density of positive cells within the nodule compared with surrounding tissue
Ring-like arrangement of positive cells around a small follicle at the upper right
No clear clustering around large cells discernible at this magnification
Fibrous capsule at the right edge with sparse positive cells
62277.describe_en: CD57 immunohistochemistry shows abundant scattered small positive cells distributed through the enlarged nodule and the interfollicular regions, with a somewhat higher density within the nodule and a ring-like distribution around a small adjacent follicle. Rosettes around large cells cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The pattern reflects increased CD57-positive T cells within and around follicles, which may be seen in progressive transformation of germinal centers; findings are consistent with PTGC when correlated with the H&E and IgD stains.

ddx.vs: NLPHL shows CD57/PD-1-positive T-cell rosettes encircling LP cells within effacing nodules, which must be excluded at high power.
Ordinary reactive follicles contain CD57-positive T cells mainly within the light zone of intact germinal centers rather than dispersed through an enlarged mantle-cell-rich nodule.

62213.recognize_zh: 同一病人的兩支採血管並排：紅頭無抗凝管的上清液呈鮮紅色（溶血），紫頭 EDTA 管血漿則清澈黃色；EDTA 螯合鈣離子阻斷補體活化，這種對比指向高效價冷凝集素引起的補體性體外溶血。
features: Clinical photograph of two blood collection tubes from the same patient
Red-top (plain, no anticoagulant) tube with bright red, transparent hemolyzed supernatant
Purple-top (K2EDTA) tube with clear yellow plasma above a red cell layer
Contrast indicates complement-dependent hemolysis in vitro that is prevented by calcium chelation
No microscopic morphology is shown
62213.describe_en: Photograph shows two blood collection tubes drawn from the same patient. The plain red-top tube contains bright red, hemoglobin-stained supernatant indicating marked in vitro hemolysis, whereas the K2EDTA purple-top tube has clear yellow plasma. Because EDTA chelates calcium and blocks the classical complement cascade, the discrepancy points to complement-mediated hemolysis occurring after sample collection at room temperature. With a positive monospecific anti-C3d DAT and a high-titer, wide-thermal-amplitude cold agglutinin, findings are consistent with complement-mediated hemolysis due to cold agglutinins.

ddx.vs: Mechanical hemolysis affects tubes regardless of anticoagulant, whereas here the EDTA tube drawn simultaneously is clear.
PCH is caused by a biphasic IgG anti-P antibody detected by the Donath-Landsteiner test, usually in children after viral infection, with a low-titer antibody.
True in vivo hemolysis would also discolor EDTA plasma and is supported by hemoglobinuria, high LDH and low haptoglobin.

62149.recognize_zh: 周邊血嗜中性球增多並有明顯毒性顆粒（toxic granulation），骨髓顆粒球系增生且可見漿細胞；流式與 CD138 染色顯示一群輕鏈限制的漿細胞，提示漿細胞腫瘤引起的類白血病反應，而非慢性嗜中性白血病。
features: Peripheral blood neutrophilia with mature segmented and band neutrophils (A)
Coarse dark toxic granulation in neutrophils at high power (B)
Hypercellular marrow with granulocytic predominance on biopsy (C) and aspirate (D)
Scattered plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm in the aspirate (D)
Flow cytometry CD45 vs SSC plot with a gated abnormal population (arrow, E)
Immunostain highlighting increased scattered plasma cells, with inset cytoplasmic light-chain plot (F)
62149.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (A, B) shows marked neutrophilia composed of mature segmented and band forms with prominent coarse toxic granulation, without circulating blasts in these fields. The bone marrow biopsy (C) and aspirate (D) are hypercellular with granulocytic hyperplasia and orderly maturation, and scattered plasma cells are present. Flow cytometry (E) identifies a distinct gated population, and immunostaining (F) highlights increased plasma cells, with the inset cytoplasmic light-chain plot supporting clonality. Findings are consistent with a neutrophilic leukemoid reaction secondary to a plasma cell neoplasm, mimicking chronic neutrophilic leukemia; absence of a CSF3R mutation would further support a reactive process.

ddx.vs: CNL shows similar mature neutrophilia with toxic granulation but carries a CSF3R mutation, whereas here the neutrophilia is driven by a clonal plasma cell population.
CML shows a left-shifted neutrophilia with myelocyte and basophil peaks and BCR::ABL1, which is not seen in a mature-only neutrophilia.
Infectious leukemoid reactions have similar toxic changes but lack a clonal plasma cell population on flow cytometry and immunostains.
aCML shows prominent granulocytic dysplasia with immature granulocytes of 10% or more, unlike the orderly mature neutrophilia here.

62149.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; flow cytometry; IHC (plasma cell marker)

62085.recognize_zh: 未染色濕式鏡檢（sickling test）中，除了圓形紅血球外，可見大量呈新月形、鐮刀狀或冬青葉狀（holly leaf）的變形紅血球，表示存在 HbS。
features: Unstained wet preparation with red cells viewed by bright-field microscopy
Numerous crescent, sickle and holly-leaf shaped red cells
Admixed round biconcave red cells that have not sickled
Some cells appear small, in keeping with microcytosis
No nucleated cells assessable in this preparation
62085.describe_en: Unstained wet-mount sickling test (reducing agent preparation) shows numerous red cells that have deformed into crescent, sickle and holly-leaf shapes, admixed with round cells that have not sickled. The positive sickling test indicates the presence of hemoglobin S but cannot distinguish sickle cell trait from sickle cell disease. Quantitation by hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC, which here showed HbS of 26.3% with microcytic indices, is required; the findings are consistent with sickle cell trait with coexisting alpha thalassemia.
