ddx.vs: The sickling test is positive in both, so HPLC is required: HbSS lacks HbA with HbS above 80%, whereas trait has HbA predominance.
HbSC is also sickle-test positive but shows HbC on electrophoresis and target cells with crystals on stained smear.
Crenated cells show evenly spaced short spicules around a round outline rather than elongated crescent or holly-leaf forms.
Beta thalassemia trait is sickling-test negative and shows elevated HbA2 above 3.5% without HbS.

62021.recognize_zh: 胸部電腦斷層（CT）橫切面上，左前胸壁與腋下有一個巨大、以軟組織密度為主的腫塊，向外隆起並延伸至左側腋窩，內部密度不均、有較低密度區（可能為壞死或感染）；巨大快速長大的軟組織腫塊符合難治性高惡度 B 細胞淋巴瘤（double-hit）的影像表現。
features: Axial CT of the upper chest at the level of the aortic arch/great vessels
Very large soft-tissue attenuation mass of the left anterior chest wall bulging the skin contour
Mass extends posterolaterally into the left axilla with heterogeneous lower-attenuation areas
Mass abuts the anterior chest wall; lungs and mediastinal vessels on this slice without obvious invasion
Non-morphologic image; tissue diagnosis cannot be made from imaging
62021.describe_en: Axial CT image of the upper chest shows a very large, predominantly homogeneous soft-tissue mass arising in the left anterior chest wall and extending into the left axilla, with heterogeneous lower-attenuation areas in its posterolateral portion that may represent necrosis or infection. The mass deforms the overlying skin contour and abuts the anterior chest wall; the lungs and mediastinal vessels at this level appear intact. Extension into the neck and possible vascular or thyroid invasion described clinically are not shown on this slice. The imaging findings of a bulky, necrotic soft-tissue mass are compatible with refractory high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, which requires tissue diagnosis for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Soft tissue sarcoma of the chest wall
ddx.vs: Imaging cannot reliably distinguish; biopsy showing a CD20+ large B-cell population with MYC/BCL2 rearrangement by FISH establishes lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma (e.g., breast) to axillary nodes/chest wall
ddx.vs: Carcinoma shows cytokeratin-positive epithelial cells on biopsy; imaging features overlap.
Abscess shows a rim-enhancing fluid collection with gas or clinical sepsis, whereas this mass is predominantly solid.

61957.recognize_zh: CD3染色中許多中型細胞呈膜狀／細胞質陽性，但其間夾雜不少CD3陰性、核較大而淡的細胞；ALK陰性ALCL常有pan-T抗原（如CD3）部分或完全喪失，陽性細胞可能包含反應性T細胞。
features: Many intermediate-sized cells with membranous and cytoplasmic CD3 staining
Admixed CD3-negative cells with larger, paler nuclei
Heterogeneous staining pattern without uniform positivity of all large cells
Faint granular cytoplasmic staining in some cells
61957.describe_en: CD3 immunostain shows numerous positive cells with membranous and cytoplasmic staining admixed with a population of CD3-negative cells with larger, paler nuclei. The staining is heterogeneous rather than uniform across the large-cell population. In ALK-negative ALCL, CD3 is frequently lost in a proportion of neoplastic cells, and positive cells may include reactive T cells; lineage assignment relies on a panel (CD2, CD4, CD5, CD43, cytotoxic markers) and TCR clonality.

ddx.vs: PTCL NOS usually retains more pan-T antigens and lacks uniform strong CD30 in hallmark cells.
HRS cells are usually CD3-negative with CD15+ and weak PAX5 in a background rich in reactive CD3+ T cells, a pattern that can mimic ALCL on CD3 alone.
Loss of T-cell markers raises concern for a B-cell lymphoma, which is excluded by negative CD20/PAX5 and positive cytotoxic markers or TCR rearrangement.

61893.recognize_zh: 同一區域 CD3 標記出大量散在及血管周圍聚集的淋巴球，數量明顯多於 CD4 與 CD8 陽性細胞，顯示浸潤以 T 細胞（或帶胞質 CD3 的細胞）為主，支持 HV 樣淋巴增生性疾病（HVLPD）中的 T 細胞浸潤。
features: Edematous dermis/subcutis with an interstitial and perivascular lymphoid infiltrate
Numerous CD3-positive small to medium lymphocytes, forming the dominant population
Positive cells cluster around small vessels and extend interstitially between collagen bundles
Membranous/cytoplasmic staining pattern with some cells showing irregular nuclear contours
CD3-positive cells appear more numerous than CD4- and CD8-positive cells in comparable fields
61893.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD3 on a skin biopsy shows an interstitial and perivascular lymphoid infiltrate within edematous dermis and subcutis. CD3 highlights numerous small to medium lymphocytes, which constitute the predominant infiltrating population and cluster around small vessels. Compared with the corresponding CD4 and CD8 stains, CD3-positive cells appear more numerous, raising the possibility of a CD4/CD8 double-negative T-cell or cytoplasmic CD3-positive NK-cell component, which should be clarified with TCR and cytotoxic markers. Together with EBER positivity, findings support an EBV-associated T/NK-cell infiltrate consistent with hydroa vacciniforme-like lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: ENKTL shows angiocentric destructive growth with extensive necrosis and CD56-positive cells, usually in adults, whereas HVLPD presents with photodistributed vesiculopapules and a less destructive infiltrate.
It shows CD3-positive, CD4/CD8 double-negative, TCR-delta-positive cytotoxic cells with an aggressive course and is typically EBER negative.
Reactive infiltrates contain mixed CD4/CD8 T cells, often with eosinophils, and lack EBER-positive lymphocytes.

61829.recognize_zh: CD68 染色在成片的大型腫瘤細胞中呈彌漫、顆粒狀的細胞質陽性（溶酶體型態），僅血管與間質陰性；支持組織球系分化，需與 CD163、PU.1 合併判讀以診斷組織球肉瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of large cells with abundant cytoplasm
Strong granular (lysosomal-pattern) cytoplasmic CD68 staining in nearly all tumor cells
Round to oval nuclei unstained by the chromogen
Small vessels and stroma negative
No cohesive epithelial architecture
61829.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD68 shows diffuse, strong, granular cytoplasmic positivity in sheets of large neoplastic cells with round to oval nuclei, while small vessels and stromal elements are negative. The granular pattern corresponds to lysosomal staining and supports histiocytic differentiation, although CD68 is not lineage-specific and can be expressed by melanoma, some carcinomas, and myeloid neoplasms. In combination with CD163 and PU.1 positivity and negative dendritic cell, myeloid, lymphoid, and epithelial markers, findings are consistent with histiocytic sarcoma.

ddx.vs: Monoblastic myeloid sarcoma may be CD68+ but typically also expresses lysozyme, CD34/CD117 or MPO in part, and shows blastic chromatin with a clinical myeloid neoplasm.
ALCL is CD30+ with T-cell or ALK expression and lacks CD163/PU.1 in the tumor cells.
Melanoma may show granular CD68 but is S100/SOX10/HMB45 positive and CD163 negative.
Reactive histiocytes lack the cytologic atypia, mitoses, and destructive sheet-like growth of histiocytic sarcoma.

61765.recognize_zh: H&E 高倍可見一致、成片的中型淋巴細胞，核圓至略不規則、染色質細緻分散、核仁不明顯、細胞質稀少，外觀近似母細胞；這種單調的「母細胞樣」細胞群是母細胞型被套細胞淋巴瘤（blastoid MCL）的線索。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular or indented nuclei with finely dispersed, blast-like chromatin
Small or inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant pale cytoplasm
Scattered small dark nuclei (possibly normoblasts or lymphocytes) and red cells between tumor cells
61765.describe_en: Sections show a diffuse infiltrate of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm. Scattered small dark nuclei and red blood cells are interspersed; the tissue site cannot be determined from this field. No follicular architecture or starry-sky pattern is seen. Morphology alone suggests a blastoid lymphoid neoplasm, and with cyclin D1/SOX11 immunostaining findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid variant.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are TdT-positive and often CD34-positive, whereas blastoid MCL is TdT-negative with surface CD5, cyclin D1 and SOX11.
Myeloblasts express MPO/CD33/CD117 and lack mature B-cell markers such as CD20 and cyclin D1.
DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and are usually cyclin D1- and SOX11-negative.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: HGBL is excluded by FISH for MYC/BCL2 and absence of CCND1 rearrangement.

61701.recognize_zh: 流式細胞儀輕鏈散佈圖（Lambda PE 對 Kappa FITC），在單一細胞閘門中 Kappa 陽性佔 99.60%、Lambda 僅 0.09%；幾乎全為單一 Kappa 輕鏈表現，代表克隆性（輕鏈限制），支持漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Bivariate dot plot gated on singlets: Lambda PE (x-axis) versus Kappa FITC (y-axis)
Kappa-positive events account for 99.60% of the gated population
Lambda-positive events only 0.09%
Small double-positive (D++) and double-negative (D--) regions with few events
Kappa:lambda ratio markedly skewed, indicating monotypic kappa expression
61701.describe_en: Flow cytometric light-chain analysis on the gated singlet population shows 99.60% kappa-positive and 0.09% lambda-positive events, with only minor double-positive and double-negative events. This markedly skewed kappa:lambda ratio indicates kappa light-chain restriction. Assuming the analysis is gated on plasma cells with cytoplasmic light-chain staining, findings demonstrate a clonal kappa-restricted plasma cell population consistent with plasma cell myeloma in the appropriate clinical and morphologic context.

61637.recognize_zh: 中高倍 CD20 染色可見大型、核卵圓且有核仁的 B 細胞呈強烈膜染色，沿竇狀血管排成一串串並環繞脂肪空泡，周圍小的造血細胞陰性；大細胞侷限在血管腔內是血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的特點。
features: Large cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD20 aligned in cords within sinusoids
Positive cells have oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin and visible nucleoli in counterstain
Chains of positive cells wrap around and between fat spaces following vascular channels
Surrounding small hematopoietic cells CD20 negative
Few isolated single positive cells
61637.describe_en: CD20 immunostain at higher magnification shows large atypical B cells with strong membranous staining arranged in chains and cords that follow sinusoidal channels between fat spaces. The positive cells have oval vesicular nuclei with visible nucleoli and are two to three times the size of the adjacent CD20-negative hematopoietic cells. No extravascular nodular aggregates are seen. The findings are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Normal marrow contains only rare small CD20-positive cells without large atypical cytology or continuous intraluminal chains.
Intrasinusoidal CD20+ cells in SMZL are small with condensed chromatin, not large cells with vesicular nuclei and nucleoli.
Similar intravascular pattern but the neoplastic cells are CD20 negative and CD3/CD56/EBER positive.

61573.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片滿是大小不一的母細胞，核圓或略凹、染色質細緻均勻、核仁不明顯，細胞質少至中等、呈藍色無顆粒，少數有小空泡；無 Auer 小體、無顆粒，型態符合淋巴母細胞，需流式確認 B 系。
features: Sheets of blasts, variably sized from medium to large, replacing normal marrow elements
High N:C ratio with scant to moderate basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented nuclei with finely dispersed homogeneous chromatin
Inconspicuous or small indistinct nucleoli
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles in a larger blast; one disrupted (smudged) cell; no Auer rods
61573.describe_en: Wright-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of blasts that vary from medium to large in size. The blasts have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to slightly indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant to moderate basophilic agranular cytoplasm; occasional cells contain a few small cytoplasmic vacuoles, and a disrupted smudged cell is present. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are not seen, and normal maturing hematopoietic elements are not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometry confirms B-lineage, and genetic testing is required for the BCR::ABL1-like designation.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar agranular blasts but MPO/CD13/CD33/CD117-positive and lacking CD19/CD10/cCD79a.
Cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with numerous sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles, coarser chromatin and a mature TdT-negative, surface-light-chain-restricted phenotype.
Shows CD5+/cyclin D1+ mature B cells without TdT or CD34.
Morphology is indistinguishable; flow shows cytoplasmic CD3 and absence of B-lineage markers.

61509.recognize_zh: CD33 免疫染色中，幾乎所有大型腫瘤細胞都呈強而瀰漫的細胞膜與細胞質陽性，細胞膜輪廓清楚，排成類似巢狀的結構；強 CD33 表現確認腫瘤為骨髓系（myeloid）來源，支持髓樣肉瘤。
features: Nearly all tumor cells show strong, diffuse CD33 staining
Crisp membranous accentuation outlining cell borders, plus granular cytoplasmic staining
Large cells with oval nuclei arranged in vague nests and cords
Nuclei appear pale and unstained, confirming non-nuclear localization
Intervening stroma and vessels are largely negative
61509.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD33 shows strong and diffuse membranous and cytoplasmic positivity in nearly all of the large neoplastic cells. The staining outlines cell borders and highlights a vaguely nested growth pattern, with intervening stroma negative. This strong expression of a myeloid-associated antigen, together with CD34 negativity and the large epithelioid morphology, supports myeloid lineage. Findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma in a patient with AML with monocytic differentiation.

ddx.vs: Histiocytic sarcoma may show some CD33 but is defined by CD163/CD68/lysozyme expression without an associated AML or blast phenotype.
BPDCN has skin-predominant blastoid cells that are CD4+, CD56+, CD123+, and TCF4+, usually lacking strong CD33 and lysozyme.
Carcinoma is keratin positive and CD33 negative, despite a similar nested membrane pattern.

61445.recognize_zh: 與上一張同一視野的反轉 DAPI 影像：灰階背景使染色體帶型清楚可辨，間期細胞見 2 融合 1 紅 1 綠，中期分裂相中融合訊號位於 der(22)（費城染色體）與 der(9)，符合 t(9;22)。
features: Inverted DAPI (grayscale) image of the same interphase nucleus and metaphase as the DAPI color view
Inverted DAPI provides a pseudo-G-banding pattern that helps identify individual chromosomes
Interphase nucleus with two fusion (yellow), one red, and one green signal (2F1R1G)
Metaphase with fusion signals on two small/derivative chromosomes (der(22) and der(9)) and separate red and green signals on normal homologs
Chromosome labels are not shown in this version
61445.describe_en: Inverted DAPI image of BCR/ABL1 dual-color dual-fusion FISH shows an interphase nucleus with a 2F1R1G signal pattern and a metaphase in which fusion signals are located on the derivative chromosomes, with single red and green signals on the normal chromosomes 9 and 22. Inverting the DAPI counterstain produces a banding pattern resembling G-bands, allowing chromosome identification for signal localization. The findings indicate a classic reciprocal t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) BCR::ABL1 rearrangement, consistent with CML in this clinical context.

ddx.vs: Loss of the reciprocal ABL1-BCR fusion on der(9) gives a 1F1R1G pattern instead of two fusions.
Duplication of der(22) produces an additional fusion signal (3F1R1G) in metaphase and interphase.
A small inserted fusion may show one small fusion on an otherwise normal-appearing chromosome with a normal karyotype.

61445.stain: FISH: BCR/ABL1 DC-DF probe, inverted DAPI

61381.recognize_zh: 血片中可見大型芽細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻，細胞質深嗜鹼性且邊緣有泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs），呈巨核芽細胞樣特徵；配合唐氏症新生兒臨床背景，符合短暫性異常骨髓生成（TAM）。
features: Large blasts with high N:C ratio and round to slightly irregular nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with irregular borders and cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopod-like projections (megakaryoblastic features)
Smaller blast with similar cytoplasmic budding at right
Band neutrophil at lower left; thick area of smear with crowded erythrocytes
61381.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts of variable size with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with irregular borders and cytoplasmic blebs, features suggestive of megakaryoblastic differentiation. A band neutrophil is also present. In a neonate with Down syndrome, these findings are consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis; confirmation of megakaryoblastic immunophenotype (CD41/CD61) and GATA1 mutation is recommended, and clinical follow-up is needed given the risk of subsequent myeloid leukemia of Down syndrome.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Blasts look the same; ML-DS typically presents after the neonatal period (usually before age 4) with persistent disease, often preceded by an MDS-like phase, rather than spontaneous resolution.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia in non-Down syndrome children
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; absence of trisomy 21 and GATA1 mutation and presence of fusions such as CBFA2T3::GLIS2 or RBM15::MRTFA distinguish it.
Lymphoblasts have scant, less basophilic cytoplasm without blebbing and express TdT and B-lineage markers rather than CD41/CD61.

ddx.dx: Neonatal leukemoid reaction or congenital infection
ddx.vs: Shows left-shifted maturing granulocytes with few or no blasts and lacks basophilic blebbing blasts.

61253.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見一群大細胞緊密黏在一起，核大、核質比高、有核仁，細胞質藍灰且部分含空泡，旁邊的中性球與紅血球顯得很小，成團且與造血細胞不同即提示轉移性腫瘤。
features: Tight three-dimensional cluster of large cells, markedly larger than adjacent neutrophils
Round to oval, variably sized nuclei with nuclear overlapping and crowding
Some nuclei with coarse speckled chromatin and small nucleoli; others dense and hyperchromatic
Moderate grayish-blue cytoplasm with ill-defined cell borders; a few small cytoplasmic vacuoles at the cluster edge
Background of red cells and scattered segmented neutrophils
61253.describe_en: High-power view of a Wright-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a tight cohesive cluster of large atypical cells with overlapping round to oval nuclei, variable chromatin texture, small nucleoli and moderate grayish-blue cytoplasm containing occasional vacuoles. Cell borders are indistinct and the cells dwarf the neighboring segmented neutrophils. No granulocytic maturation or megakaryocytic lobation is seen within the cluster. Findings are consistent with metastatic non-hematopoietic tumor (carcinoma) in the marrow; immunohistochemistry on the core biopsy is needed to establish the primary site.

ddx.vs: A megakaryocyte has one lobulated nucleus within a single cell, whereas this cluster contains many discrete nuclei in separate cells.
Myeloma cells have eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof and do not form true cohesive aggregates.
Osteoblasts show eccentric nuclei with a pale hof distant from the nucleus and bland chromatin, arranged loosely rather than overlapping.

61189.recognize_zh: 脾臟切片中，淋巴細胞之間散佈大量細胞質豐富、呈亮粉紅色、多角或紡錘形的組織球，細胞質內像是被長條結晶撐滿，核被擠到周邊，符合結晶貯積組織球（crystal-storing histiocytes）。
features: Numerous histiocytes with abundant, dense, bright eosinophilic cytoplasm, polygonal to spindle-shaped, distended by crystalline material
Histiocyte nuclei are small and displaced to the periphery or inconspicuous
Intervening lymphoid cells including cells with irregular, lobulated or clumped nuclei
Bands of pink collagenous/fibrillary stroma traversing the field
Occasional plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei
61189.describe_en: Section of spleen shows numerous scattered histiocytes with abundant, dense, bright eosinophilic polygonal to spindled cytoplasm that appears distended by crystalline material, with small peripherally displaced nuclei. These are admixed with lymphoid cells, some with irregular or lobulated nuclei, and bands of collagenous stroma. Findings are consistent with crystal-storing histiocytosis; because this lesion is usually associated with an underlying lymphoplasmacytic or plasma cell neoplasm secreting monoclonal immunoglobulin (typically kappa), evaluation of the background lymphoid population with immunohistochemistry and light-chain studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: Skeletal muscle cells are desmin and myogenin positive with true cross-striations, whereas crystal-storing histiocytes are CD68/CD163 positive and contain immunoglobulin light chain.
Granular cell tumor cells have finely granular S100/SOX10-positive cytoplasm rather than elongated crystalline inclusions.
Gaucher cells have pale 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than dense bright eosinophilic crystals.
Spindled histiocytes in mycobacterial infection are filled with acid-fast bacilli on AFB stain rather than eosinophilic crystals.

61125.recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片的 lambda 原位雜交（ISH）中，真皮內圍繞附屬器及血管的浸潤區有大量深紫色訊號陽性細胞，陽性細胞數量多、分布廣，與同案 kappa ISH 對照可判斷為 lambda 限制性漿細胞。
features: Scanning magnification of a skin biopsy with epidermis at top and dermis/subcutis below
Numerous dark purple lambda mRNA-positive cells within dermal infiltrate
Positive cells clustered in perivascular, periadnexal and deep dermal nodular aggregates
Pale eosinophilic counterstained collagen with fewer positive cells in the superficial dermis
Individual cell morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification
61125.describe_en: In situ hybridization for lambda light chain mRNA on a skin biopsy, viewed at scanning magnification, shows numerous strongly positive cells distributed in perivascular, periadnexal and deep dermal nodular aggregates. The superficial dermis contains scattered positive cells, and the epidermis is negative. Individual cell morphology cannot be evaluated at this power. When compared with a paired kappa ISH showing few positive cells, the findings indicate lambda-restricted plasmacytic cells, supporting a clonal B-cell process consistent with extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasma cell-rich dermatitis or syphilis
ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates show a polytypic kappa-to-lambda ratio of roughly 2:1, not a marked lambda predominance.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous involvement by plasma cell myeloma
ddx.vs: Myeloma forms sheets of atypical plasma cells without a background small B-cell and T-cell rich infiltrate and has a marrow correlate.
Follicle center lymphoma consists of centrocytes and centroblasts that are BCL6/CD10 positive and lacks prominent light-chain-restricted plasma cells.

61061.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一團彼此黏附（cohesive）、核呈卵圓形且互相擠壓（nuclear molding）、有核仁的大型細胞聚集，形態與周圍造血細胞明顯不同，符合非造血性腫瘤轉移（本例為攝護腺癌）。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells with shared, poorly defined pale-blue cytoplasm
Oval to elongated nuclei with overlapping and molding
Finely granular chromatin with visible small nucleoli
Some fine purple cytoplasmic granularity on the left portion of the cluster
Surrounded by smaller hematopoietic cells and red cells; image has a yellow color cast with out-of-focus background
61061.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive clump of large atypical cells with ill-defined cell borders, oval overlapping nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli, distinctly larger than and morphologically foreign to the surrounding hematopoietic elements. Focal fine cytoplasmic granularity is noted. Cohesion and syncytial-like arrangement favor an epithelial origin. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma, compatible with the clinical history of prostatic adenocarcinoma; confirmation by biopsy with immunostains (e.g., NKX3.1, PSA) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus with granular cytoplasm and discrete borders, not multiple separate molded nuclei in a cohesive group.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a distant hof and are not overlapping, while osteoclasts contain many discrete uniform round nuclei in one cell.

ddx.dx: Clusters of lymphoma or acute leukemia cells
ddx.vs: Hematopoietic neoplasms are discohesive single cells, whereas true cohesion and nuclear molding indicate a non-hematopoietic tumor.

60997.recognize_zh: 淋巴結副皮質區見成簇、淡染的中型細胞（漿細胞樣樹突細胞，pDC），CD123 呈大片團塊陽性、granzyme B 與 CD68 散在陽性，但 BCL2 與 CD56 在團塊內為陰性，另有伴核碎屑的壞死灶，支持紅斑性狼瘡淋巴結炎而非腫瘤性 pDC。
features: Low power: follicular and paracortical hyperplasia with pale nodular paracortical aggregates
High power: clusters of medium-sized cells with round-oval nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm (plasmacytoid dendritic cells)
Focal paracortical necrosis with karyorrhectic nuclear debris and basophilic hematoxylin-body-like material
IHC: CD123 strongly highlights confluent pDC clusters; CD68 and granzyme B positive in the same areas
IHC: pDC clusters negative for BCL2 (BCL2-poor zone) and CD56
60997.describe_en: Lymph node sections show follicular and paracortical hyperplasia with pale paracortical nodules composed of clusters of medium-sized cells with oval nuclei and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm. Focal paracortical necrosis with abundant karyorrhectic debris and hematoxylin bodies is present; neutrophils are not conspicuous. By immunohistochemistry, the clusters are CD123-positive with CD68 and granzyme B coexpression and are negative for BCL2 and CD56. Findings are consistent with reactive plasmacytoid dendritic cell hyperplasia in the setting of lupus lymphadenitis.

ddx.vs: Shares pDC clusters and karyorrhexis, but lacks hematoxylin bodies, plasma-cell rich infiltrate and serologic lupus; distinction often requires clinical/ANA correlation.
Neoplastic pDCs form diffuse sheets of blastoid cells that are CD56-positive, often TdT-positive and BCL2-positive, whereas these reactive clusters are CD56- and BCL2-negative.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with mature pDC proliferation (e.g., CMML-associated)
ddx.vs: Occurs with an underlying myeloid neoplasm in marrow/blood and nodules may show clonal markers, unlike this reactive node with necrosis in a lupus patient.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin or T-cell lymphoma with necrosis
ddx.vs: Would show atypical large cells (CD30/CD15 or aberrant T-cell phenotype) rather than bland CD123-positive pDC clusters.

60997.stain: H&E; IHC: CD123, CD68, granzyme B, BCL2, CD56

60805.recognize_zh: CD3 染色可見大量 T 細胞環狀聚集並侵入毛囊漏斗部上皮（亦即親毛囊性），毛囊周圍真皮也有密集 CD3 陽性浸潤，而表皮（右上）相對少見，這是親毛囊型蕈狀肉芽腫（folliculotropic MF）的線索。
features: Cross-sectioned hair follicles with central keratin/hair shaft surrounded by follicular epithelium
Dense ring-like infiltration of CD3+ lymphocytes within the outer follicular epithelium (folliculotropism)
Perifollicular and dermal CD3+ T-cell infiltrate, including a larger aggregate in the lower field
Relative sparing of the interfollicular epidermis (upper right) in this field
Positive cells show membranous staining; cytologic atypia is difficult to assess on IHC
60805.describe_en: Skin biopsy stained for CD3 shows several hair follicle infundibula cut in cross section, with a dense, ring-like infiltrate of CD3-positive T cells permeating the follicular epithelium. A perifollicular and dermal CD3-positive infiltrate is also present, whereas the adjacent interfollicular epidermis shows relatively few intraepithelial T cells. No follicular mucinosis can be assessed on this immunostain. In the appropriate clinical and H&E context, findings are consistent with folliculotropic mycosis fungoides.

ddx.vs: Atypical T cells preferentially colonize the interfollicular epidermis (Pautrier microabscesses) rather than follicular epithelium with epidermal sparing.
Shows follicular mucin with a less dense, cytologically bland infiltrate and usually no clonal dominant T-cell population.
Contains mixed inflammation (neutrophils, eosinophils, B cells) and polyclonal T cells without prominent intrafollicular atypical T-cell colonization.

ddx.dx: Lymphocytic infiltrate of lupus or lichen planopilaris
ddx.vs: Show interface change at the follicle with basal vacuolization and perifollicular fibrosis rather than dense intraepithelial atypical T cells.

60613.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中巨噬細胞胞質內可見金褐色、粗顆粒狀的含鐵血黃素（hemosiderin），Prussian blue 染色呈大團深藍色鐵沉積集中在巨噬細胞內；下方示意圖說明 hepcidin 使 ferroportin 被內吞分解，鐵被困在巨噬細胞與腸細胞內，即慢性疾病貧血的機轉。
features: H&E: scattered macrophages containing coarse golden-brown refractile hemosiderin granules (inset), within a cellular marrow
Prussian blue: markedly increased storage iron as large dark-blue clumps within macrophages (inset)
Blue iron is concentrated in macrophages rather than dispersed as siderotic granules in erythroid precursors
Schematic: hepcidin binds ferroportin on enterocytes and macrophages, causing its internalization and lysosomal degradation, blocking iron export
60613.describe_en: The bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a cellular marrow with scattered macrophages containing coarse golden-brown hemosiderin pigment. Prussian blue staining demonstrates increased storage iron sequestered within macrophages as large clumps. The accompanying schematic illustrates hepcidin-mediated internalization and degradation of ferroportin in enterocytes and macrophages, which reduces intestinal iron absorption and traps iron in the reticuloendothelial system. Findings are consistent with iron-restricted erythropoiesis with increased macrophage iron in anemia of chronic inflammation associated with autoimmune disease.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows absent stainable storage iron in marrow macrophages, the opposite of the abundant macrophage iron seen here.
Iron overload shows increased iron in both macrophages and parenchymal cells with high transferrin saturation, rather than low saturation with iron trapping.
Sideroblastic anemia shows ring sideroblasts with perinuclear iron in erythroblasts, not iron confined to macrophages.

ddx.dx: Other brown pigments (e.g., formalin pigment, melanin)
ddx.vs: Hemosiderin is confirmed by Prussian blue positivity, whereas formalin pigment and melanin are Prussian blue-negative.

60677.recognize_zh: C 圖周邊血嗜酸性球的顆粒大小與顏色不一，混有紫黑色嗜鹼樣顆粒與橘紅色顆粒，核分葉異常；A、B 圖電子顯微鏡下顆粒呈均質或斑駁、缺乏典型的中央結晶核心，代表嗜酸性球發育不良（dysplastic eosinophil），見於具 MDS 相關變化的 AML。
features: Wright-Giemsa (C): eosinophil with abnormal nuclear lobation and mixed granules, including dark purple basophilic-appearing granules among orange-red eosinophilic granules
Uneven granule distribution with areas of granule-poor cytoplasm
Transmission EM (A): whole eosinophil with numerous round, electron-dense cytoplasmic granules
EM detail (B, boxed area): granules of variable density lacking the well-defined central crystalline core typical of mature specific granules
Surrounding red cells show central refractile artifacts; not interpretable as specific inclusions
60677.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (panel C) shows an eosinophil with irregular nuclear lobation and heterogeneous cytoplasmic granules, with admixed dark purple, basophilic-staining (immature, pro-eosinophilic) granules among orange eosinophilic granules. Transmission electron microscopy (panels A and B) shows numerous round cytoplasmic granules that, at higher magnification, have mottled or homogeneous matrices without the typical electron-dense central crystalloid core. These light and ultrastructural findings indicate defective eosinophil granule maturation. In a patient with AML, findings are consistent with eosinophil dysplasia as part of myelodysplasia-related changes.

ddx.vs: Inv(16) AML shows abnormal eosinophil precursors with large purple-violet basophilic granules in the marrow, so cytogenetics/molecular testing for CBFB::MYH11 is needed to separate it.

ddx.dx: Normal eosinophil with overlapping basophilic granules
ddx.vs: Normal eosinophils have uniform orange-red refractile granules and bilobed nuclei; EM shows specific granules with a central crystalline core.
Basophils have large dark granules that obscure the nucleus and lack orange granules, whereas this cell contains mostly eosinophilic granules with only some immature basophilic ones.
Reactive eosinophils may be hypogranular or vacuolated but do not show persistent immature basophilic granules or loss of crystalloid cores with accompanying multilineage dysplasia.

60741.recognize_zh: 周邊血嗜酸性球增多並伴隨核略不規則的非典型淋巴球，流式可見一群表面抗原異常的 T 細胞（框選處）；淋巴結副皮質區擴張、混有許多嗜酸性球，CD2 陽性但 CD7 大量流失，形似周邊 T 細胞淋巴瘤，實為淋巴球變異型嗜酸性球增多症候群。
features: Panel A (PB): increased mature eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and orange granules
Panel A (PB): small-to-medium lymphocytes with mildly irregular/indented nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm
Panel B: flow cytometry plots with a gated aberrant T-cell population (red) separated from normal T cells (axis labels not legible)
Panel C (LN low power): preserved follicles with markedly expanded paracortex
Panel D (LN high power): polymorphous paracortical infiltrate of small-to-medium lymphocytes with numerous eosinophils and high endothelial venules
Panel E: CD2 diffusely positive in the paracortex; CD7 positive in only scattered cells (loss of CD7)
60741.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows eosinophilia accompanied by atypical small-to-medium lymphocytes with irregular nuclei, and flow cytometry identifies a distinct aberrant T-cell population. The lymph node shows preserved follicles with marked paracortical expansion by a polymorphous infiltrate rich in eosinophils; immunostains show diffuse CD2 expression with loss of CD7 in most paracortical T cells. In context, findings are consistent with the lymphocytic variant of hypereosinophilic syndrome driven by an aberrant cytokine-producing T-cell clone (typically CD3−CD4+ or CD7−), which can mimic peripheral T-cell lymphoma and requires clinical correlation and follow-up.

ddx.vs: PTCL effaces nodal architecture with sheets of cytologically atypical T cells and broader antigen loss, whereas L-HES preserves follicles with a mild aberrant population and indolent course.
AITL shows expanded FDC meshworks, arborizing HEVs and TFH markers (PD1, CXCL13, ICOS) with EBV+ B blasts.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion
ddx.vs: These carry PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangements with myeloid marrow abnormalities and lack a cytokine-producing aberrant T-cell clone.
Reactive hyperplasia has an immunophenotypically normal T-cell population without CD7 loss or a clonal aberrant subset.

60741.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD2, CD7; flow cytometry

60357.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD123 免疫染色：脂肪空泡之間成片的腫瘤細胞呈強而瀰漫的膜／細胞質棕色染色，陽性細胞佔絕大多數；CD123 強陽性加上 CD4、CD56 是 BPDCN 的關鍵組合。
features: Marrow core with clusters and sheets of intermediate-sized cells between adipocytes
CD123: strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining in the majority of neoplastic cells
Tumor nuclei oval to irregular with fine chromatin on hematoxylin counterstain
Scattered negative small cells and stromal/endothelial elements serve as internal negative background
60357.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD123 on the bone marrow core biopsy highlights a diffuse infiltrate of intermediate-sized cells occupying the marrow spaces between adipocytes. The majority of the neoplastic cells show strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD123 expression, while interspersed small residual cells and stromal elements are negative. Strong, diffuse CD123 in a blastic infiltrate coexpressing CD4 and CD56 is consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with CD123 expression
ddx.vs: CD123 is frequently expressed in AML, so MPO, lysozyme and absence of TCF4/TCL1/CD303 are needed to exclude AML.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation associated with myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: These form clusters of mature-appearing CD123+ cells that are usually CD56-negative and accompany CMML or other myeloid neoplasms rather than forming diffuse blastic sheets.
Hairy cells are CD123+ but are mature B cells expressing CD20, annexin A1, CD103 and BRAF V600E with 'fried-egg' morphology.

60165.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片白血球明顯增多，多數嗜中性球核分葉少（雙葉或帶狀、類Pelger-Huët型），胞質顆粒稀少而偏淡，並夾雜胞核圓形、胞質較多的未成熟顆粒球（myelocyte），但沒有嗜鹼性球或單核球增多，符合非典型慢性骨髓性白血病（aCML）。
features: Leukocytosis with numerous neutrophilic cells in a single field
Dysplastic neutrophils: hypolobated (bilobed, band-like, pseudo-Pelger) nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin
Hypogranular, pale pink-gray neutrophil cytoplasm
Circulating immature granulocytes (myelocytes) with round to indented nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm
No basophils or increase in monocytes in this field; red cells largely normocytic with mild anisocytosis
60165.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed predominantly of neutrophils and circulating immature granulocytes, including myelocytes. Neutrophils are dysplastic, with hypolobated, band-like and bilobed (pseudo-Pelger) nuclei and hypogranular cytoplasm. Basophils are not seen and monocytes are not increased in this field; red cells show mild anisocytosis and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with atypical chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-negative, pending exclusion of BCR::ABL1 and correlation with the marrow findings.

ddx.vs: CML shows a myelocyte peak with absolute basophilia and no significant dysgranulopoiesis, and BCR::ABL1 is detected.
CNL has mature, normally granulated segmented neutrophils (often toxic granulation) with <10% circulating precursors and CSF3R mutation.
CMML requires peripheral monocytes ≥10% of leukocytes and ≥0.5–1×10^9/L, whereas monocytes are not increased here.
A leukemoid reaction shows toxic granulation and Döhle bodies with normally lobated neutrophils rather than hypogranular pseudo-Pelger forms.

60101.recognize_zh: 四格合成圖中的芽細胞都有深藍、無顆粒的細胞質，邊緣呈泡狀突起或多角尖突，右下還有一片脫落的無核細胞質碎片；這種帶 blebs 的芽細胞與類血小板碎片是巨核母細胞的典型型態。
features: Blasts with high N:C ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei and fine chromatin
Deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs and angular pseudopod-like projections
Anucleate basophilic cytoplasmic fragment (lower right panel), consistent with megakaryocytic cytoplasmic budding
Smaller blast with scant cytoplasm in the lower left panel
Background red cells with anisopoikilocytosis; platelets markedly reduced
60101.describe_en: Composite images of the peripheral blood show blasts with a high N:C ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm that forms irregular blebs and angular projections. One panel shows an anucleate basophilic cytoplasmic fragment consistent with megakaryocytic budding, and platelets are markedly reduced throughout. No Auer rods or granules are seen. Findings are suggestive of acute megakaryoblastic leukemia; confirmation requires flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry for CD41, CD61 and/or CD42b.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts lack megakaryocytic antigens (CD41/CD61), whereas megakaryoblasts express them.
Lymphoblasts lack cytoplasmic blebbing and express TdT with B- or T-lineage markers.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma) in young children
ddx.vs: Tumor cells in marrow form cohesive clusters and are CD45-negative, while megakaryoblasts are CD45+ and CD61+.

ddx.dx: Blast phase of a myeloproliferative neoplasm
ddx.vs: Megakaryoblastic blast phase can look identical but shows a prior MPN history and driver mutations such as JAK2, CALR, MPL or BCR::ABL1.

60037.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆紅系前驅細胞，灰粉色的細胞質內含五個大小不一、染色質濃縮的圓形細胞核（多核化 multinucleation），代表紅系發育不良；周圍另有數顆大型母細胞，符合伴隨骨髓發育不良變化的 AML。
features: Erythroid precursor containing five round, variably sized, dense pyknotic nuclei (multinucleation)
Orthochromatic-stage gray-pink cytoplasm indicating hemoglobinization of the dysplastic erythroid cell
Several adjacent large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, and basophilic cytoplasm
Granulocytic precursor with indented nucleus at top and a normoblast at bottom
No Auer rods identified in the visible blasts
60037.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an erythroid precursor with five discrete, variably sized nuclei with condensed chromatin in hemoglobinized cytoplasm, a feature of dyserythropoiesis. Nearby are several large blasts with fine chromatin, high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio, and basophilic agranular cytoplasm, along with a maturing granulocytic precursor and a normoblast. Auer rods are not seen. Findings demonstrate erythroid dysplasia in the background of increased blasts, consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic erythroid precursors can be multinucleated but show open sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, and blasts are not increased.

ddx.dx: Congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II or III
ddx.vs: CDA shows binucleate or giant multinucleated erythroblasts in a young patient without increased myeloid blasts or granulocytic dysplasia.

ddx.dx: Toxic or drug effect (e.g., alcohol, chemotherapy, arsenic)
ddx.vs: Toxic dyserythropoiesis lacks an increase in blasts and resolves after exposure is removed.
Pure erythroid leukemia requires more than 80% erythroid cells with at least 30% proerythroblasts, rather than dysplastic late normoblasts accompanying myeloblasts.

28741.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中成片大型多角形組織球，胞質充滿嗜酸性、纖維狀的結晶物質而把核擠到一邊；抹片可見含結晶的組織球與胞質有包涵體的漿細胞，輕鏈免疫染色只有一側陽性，符合伴隨單株漿細胞腫瘤的結晶儲存組織球增生症（crystal-storing histiocytosis）。
features: Hypercellular marrow with interstitial sheets of large pale-to-bright eosinophilic cells between hematopoietic elements (panel A)
Large polygonal histiocytes with abundant densely eosinophilic, fibrillary to crystalline cytoplasm and small eccentric, compressed nuclei (panel B)
Aspirate histiocyte stuffed with purple needle- or rod-shaped crystalline material (panel C)
Plasma cell with eccentric nucleus and basophilic cytoplasm containing pink-red crystalline inclusions (panel D)
Paired immunostains with cytoplasmic staining in scattered plasma cells for one marker and absence of staining for the other (panels E, F), consistent with light-chain restriction
28741.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy is hypercellular and contains interstitial aggregates and sheets of large histiocytes with abundant densely eosinophilic, fibrillary-crystalline cytoplasm that displaces small nuclei to the periphery. The aspirate shows histiocytes distended by needle-shaped crystalline material and plasma cells harboring intracytoplasmic crystalline inclusions. Paired immunostains show staining of plasma cells for one light chain/heavy chain marker and no staining for the counterpart, supporting a clonal plasma cell population. Findings are consistent with crystal-storing histiocytosis associated with a plasma cell neoplasm (IgD kappa by clinical correlation).

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have pale 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than dense eosinophilic crystals and lack a light-chain-restricted plasma cell population.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterial infection (e.g. MAI in pseudo-Gaucher histiocytes)
ddx.vs: Mycobacterial histiocytes have striated grey-blue cytoplasm with acid-fast bacilli, whereas crystal-storing histiocytes contain immunoglobulin crystals that stain with the clonal light chain.
These are CD68-negative non-hematopoietic tumors (desmin/myogenin or S100/SOX10 positive) and do not accompany a clonal plasma cell proliferation.

ddx.dx: Adult Fanconi syndrome-type light chain crystal deposition in plasma cells only
ddx.vs: Crystalline inclusions confined to plasma cells lack the sheets of crystal-laden histiocytes seen here.

27333.recognize_zh: 低倍下看似反應性淋巴濾泡，但部分「生發中心」呈星空樣（starry sky）且外有外套區包覆；免疫染色中只有其中兩個濾泡呈瀰漫密集的核陽性，其餘生發中心僅散在陽性——代表 Burkitt 淋巴瘤殖入並「偽裝」成生發中心的濾泡性生長型態。
features: Panel A (H&E): nodular follicle-like structures with intact mantle zones under a mucosal/serosal surface
Some follicle centers show starry-sky pattern with interspersed tingible-body macrophages
Monotonous medium-sized cells in the involved follicles
Panel B (IHC, nuclear stain): two follicles with diffuse, dense nuclear positivity
Other germinal centers show only scattered positive nuclei, as in reactive follicles
27333.describe_en: Low-power section (A) shows multiple follicle-like nodules surrounded by preserved mantle zones, some with a starry-sky appearance due to tingible-body macrophages among monotonous medium-sized cells. A nuclear immunohistochemical stain (B; antibody not labeled, pattern suggestive of MYC) shows diffuse, dense nuclear positivity confined to two of the nodules, while the remaining germinal centers show only scattered positive cells, in keeping with reactive follicles. Findings are consistent with Burkitt lymphoma with a follicular/germinal center colonization pattern adjacent to reactive follicles; confirmation requires CD10/BCL6 positivity, BCL2 negativity, Ki-67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers show polarization, a polymorphous cell mix and only scattered MYC-positive cells, rather than diffuse MYC-positive monotonous sheets.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma, high grade (grade 3B) / pediatric-type follicular lymphoma
ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma lacks MYC rearrangement and a near-100% Ki-67 index, and adult-type cases express BCL2.
Resembles Burkitt morphologically but lacks MYC rearrangement and shows 11q gain/loss, often with more pleomorphism.
DLBCL cells are larger and more pleomorphic, often BCL2-positive, with a Ki-67 index usually below 90%.

14085.recognize_zh: 中型母細胞核質比高、染色質細緻，灰藍色無顆粒的細胞質中常見沿細胞膜排列的小空泡（珍珠項鍊狀），並伸出偽足樣尾巴（hand-mirror），配合臉部與軀幹棕紅色皮膚斑塊，符合母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤（BPDCN）。
features: Medium-sized blasts with round to slightly irregular or indented nuclei and high to moderate N:C ratio
Finely dispersed chromatin with small or inconspicuous nucleoli
Agranular gray-blue cytoplasm concentrated at one pole, often forming tail-like pseudopods (hand-mirror shape, panels F–G)
Small cytoplasmic vacuoles aligned beneath the cell membrane in a 'pearl necklace' pattern (panels A, D, H)
No Auer rods or azurophilic granules; background red cells unremarkable
14085.describe_en: Blood/marrow smears (panels A–H) show medium-sized blastic cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cytoplasm is agranular and gray-blue, often eccentric and drawn into tail-like pseudopods, and contains small vacuoles arranged along the cytoplasmic membrane in a pearl-necklace pattern. Auer rods and granules are absent. In a patient with brown-red cutaneous plaques, findings are suggestive of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm; flow cytometry for CD4, CD56, CD123, TCL1 and TCF4 with lack of lineage-specific markers is required (the listed category of interdigitating dendritic cell sarcoma does not correspond to this image).

ddx.vs: Monoblasts often show fine azurophilic granules and nonspecific esterase positivity with CD11c/CD14/CD64 and lysozyme expression, whereas BPDCN is CD123 bright, TCL1+, TCF4+ and MPO/lysozyme negative.
NK neoplasms are CD56+ but express cytotoxic granules (TIA-1, granzyme B), cytoplasmic CD3ε and EBV (EBER), and are CD4/CD123 negative.
T-ALL blasts express cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT with scant cytoplasm and no pearl-necklace vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation associated with CMML
ddx.vs: Mature pDC nodules consist of bland cells lacking CD56 and blastic morphology, occurring with a myeloid neoplasm.

14405.recognize_zh: A 圖骨髓抹片中一團緊密黏附的大型細胞簇（cohesive cluster），核大、細胞質深藍、細胞界線不清，與周圍造血細胞明顯不同；B 圖切片中淡藍色黏液池內漂浮著腺體上皮條帶（箭頭），符合轉移性（黏液性）腺癌侵犯骨髓。
features: Cohesive three-dimensional cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells on the aspirate smear
High N:C ratio with overlapping, molded oval nuclei and indistinct cell borders
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with small vacuoles; background of RBCs and scattered marrow cells
Biopsy: pools of pale extracellular mucin containing strips of columnar epithelium (arrow)
Marrow fat and a bony trabecula at the edge; normal hematopoiesis largely replaced in the field
14405.describe_en: The bone marrow aspirate smear (A) contains a tightly cohesive cluster of large epithelial-appearing cells with high N:C ratio, overlapping and molded oval nuclei, and basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm, clearly distinct from the surrounding hematopoietic elements. The core biopsy (B) shows the intertrabecular space replaced by lakes of pale extracellular mucin lined and traversed by strips of columnar epithelium (arrow), with residual fat adjacent to a bony trabecula. Findings are consistent with metastatic mucinous adenocarcinoma involving the bone marrow; immunohistochemistry (e.g., keratins, CDX2, TTF-1, PSA/NKX3.1) is recommended to suggest a primary site.

ddx.vs: Gelatinous transformation shows amorphous hyaluronic acid-rich ground substance with fat atrophy but no epithelial cells lining or floating within the matrix.

ddx.dx: Clumped megakaryocytes or osteoblast clusters on aspirate
ddx.vs: Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and megakaryocytes are lobulated with granular cytoplasm, whereas carcinoma cells form molded, cohesive syncytial clumps.

ddx.dx: Acute leukemia or lymphoma with cellular clumping
ddx.vs: Hematolymphoid blasts are discohesive and CD45-positive, while metastatic carcinoma is cohesive and cytokeratin-positive/CD45-negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These occur mainly in children, may form rosettes, and lack gland formation and mucin production.

captions: A: Aspirate smear with a cohesive cluster of carcinoma cells
B: Core biopsy with mucin pools and strips of glandular epithelium (arrow)

2821.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中，一個骨髓顆粒（particle）邊緣聚集了約十個大型巨核細胞（megakaryocyte），數量明顯增加，其餘造血細胞與脂肪空泡正常，這種「巨核細胞增多但周邊血小板低」的組合支持免疫性血小板低下症（ITP）。
features: Increased megakaryocytes, including a cluster of about ten at the edge of a marrow particle
Megakaryocytes appear relatively small to medium sized with dense cytoplasm at this magnification
Cellular marrow particle with interspersed fat vacuoles
Trilineage hematopoietic cells in the trails without an obvious blast population
Few free platelets in the background
2821.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate shows a cellular particle with interspersed fat spaces. Megakaryocytes are increased, with a cluster of approximately ten megakaryocytes along the particle edge and additional megakaryocytes in the adjacent trails. The surrounding hematopoietic elements show no obvious blast population, and few platelets are seen in the background. Detailed megakaryocyte morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification. In a patient with isolated thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with increased peripheral platelet destruction such as immune thrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes (micromegakaryocytes, separated or hypolobated nuclei) and dysplasia in other lineages, which require high-power review.

ddx.dx: Myeloproliferative neoplasm (e.g., essential thrombocythemia, early PMF)
ddx.vs: MPNs have increased large or bizarre, clustered megakaryocytes with normal or high platelet counts rather than thrombocytopenia.
Production failure shows reduced or absent megakaryocytes, the opposite of this image.
Inherited disorders usually show normal megakaryocyte numbers with giant platelets on smear and a lifelong or familial history.

3909.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓顆粒呈網狀，幾乎全是大小不一的脂肪空泡與基質，只有稀疏散在的細胞，缺乏造血細胞群與巨核細胞，符合再生不良性貧血的脂肪性低細胞骨髓。
features: Low-power view of a marrow particle composed mainly of fat vacuoles of varying size
Delicate stromal and capillary meshwork forming a lacy particle outline
Sparse scattered nucleated cells within the stroma; hematopoietic cells markedly reduced
No megakaryocytes and no dense cellular hematopoietic areas identified
Hemodiluted background of red cells with few leukocytes; detailed cytology limited at this magnification
3909.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate shows a particle composed almost entirely of fat vacuoles supported by a delicate stromal network. Hematopoietic cells are markedly decreased, and megakaryocytes are not identified. The surrounding smear is hemodilute with scant nucleated cells. Findings are consistent with a markedly hypocellular (fatty) marrow as seen in aplastic anemia; confirm on trephine biopsy and exclude hypocellular MDS or leukemia.

ddx.vs: Hypocellular MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes or myeloid cells, ring sideroblasts or increased CD34-positive cells, and often clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
Elderly marrow is fattier but still retains trilineage hematopoiesis and megakaryocytes appropriate for age, without peripheral pancytopenia.
Serous fat atrophy shows gelatinous pink extracellular material with hypocellularity rather than clean fat vacuoles.

3845.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片的骨髓小粒周圍可見許多深藍色的大型巨核細胞，數量明顯多於一般，夾在脂肪空泡之間；配合 HIV 病人血小板低下，代表周邊破壞增加時骨髓巨核細胞代償性增生。
features: Low-power aspirate particle with interspersed large clear fat vacuoles
Increased numbers of megakaryocytes, appearing as large dark blue cells with abundant cytoplasm, several clustered together
Megakaryocytes vary in size; lobulation and dysplasia cannot be assessed at this magnification
Adequate background trilineage hematopoietic cells around the particle
No obvious clusters of atypical or non-hematopoietic cells
3845.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows cellular particles with interspersed fat vacuoles and adequate trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes are conspicuously increased, appearing as numerous large dark-staining cells, some in small clusters. Megakaryocyte maturation and nuclear lobation require higher-power evaluation, and no atypical cell clusters are evident. In a patient with HIV and thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with megakaryocytic hyperplasia due to peripheral platelet destruction (immune thrombocytopenia).

ddx.vs: The marrow picture is identical, so the distinction rests on HIV serology and clinical context.
MPNs show large hyperlobated megakaryocytes with thrombocytosis rather than thrombocytopenia, and harbor JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations.
MDS megakaryocytes are small, hypolobated or have separated lobes, often with dysplasia in other lineages.

ddx.dx: HIV-associated marrow involvement by lymphoma or infection
ddx.vs: These show granulomas, organisms or atypical lymphoid infiltrates rather than isolated megakaryocytic hyperplasia.

3461.recognize_zh: H&E 左側為核有凹陷與核溝、胞質淡嗜酸性的組織球樣細胞，右上方聚集大量亮紅色顆粒胞質的嗜酸性球（部分為未成熟嗜酸性前驅細胞），這種 LCH 細胞加上嗜酸性球密集浸潤是蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症（LCH）的典型組合。
features: Sheets of histiocytoid cells with moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval to reniform grooved or indented nuclei (left and center)
Dense aggregate of eosinophils with bright red granular cytoplasm and bilobed or round nuclei (upper right), forming an eosinophilic microabscess-like cluster
Fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli in the lesional cells
Scattered small lymphocytes and loose fibrinous/edematous stroma
3461.describe_en: Section shows sheets of histiocytoid cells with moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval to reniform nuclei bearing grooves and indentations, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. A dense aggregate of eosinophils, including some with round nuclei, is present at one side of the field, and scattered lymphocytes are admixed. No significant pleomorphism or necrosis is seen. Findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis; confirmation by CD1a and langerin (CD207) immunohistochemistry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Hodgkin lymphoma contains large Reed-Sternberg cells with prominent inclusion-like nucleoli that are CD30/CD15-positive, rather than sheets of grooved CD1a-positive cells.
Kimura disease shows florid follicular hyperplasia, eosinophilic microabscesses and vascular proliferation without sheets of Langerhans cells.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are larger with emperipolesis, round nucleolated nuclei and are CD1a-negative, usually without eosinophil aggregates.
Myeloid neoplasms show immature myeloid/eosinophilic precursors with blasts and lack a population of grooved CD1a/langerin-positive cells.

3141.recognize_zh: 紅血球之間有一大團由許多單顆血小板緊密聚集、邊緣不規則、中央帶紫色顆粒的團塊，旁邊是一顆單核球，典型的血小板凝集（可導致假性血小板低下）。
features: Large irregular aggregate of numerous individual platelets with purple granulomeres and pale hyalomeres
Aggregate is anucleate with ragged, feathery margins
Adjacent monocyte with folded nucleus and gray vacuolated cytoplasm
A lymphocyte and a smudged cell at the upper left
Erythrocytes largely normocytic without significant poikilocytosis
3141.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large aggregate of platelets composed of many discrete granular platelets without a nucleus, adjacent to a monocyte. Red cells are unremarkable in this field. Platelet clumping of this kind can falsely lower the automated platelet count (pseudothrombocytopenia, often EDTA-dependent); correlation with a citrate-anticoagulated sample or a smear review is recommended.

ddx.vs: True thrombocytopenia shows few platelets without aggregates on the smear, whereas clumps indicate an artifactually low analyzer count.
In satellitism platelets rim neutrophils individually rather than forming free aggregates.
Stain precipitate is refractile and lacks hyalomere/granulomere structure; organisms are uniform in size and shape.

1413.recognize_zh: 單色藍染的骨髓切片中，髓腔被一致的漿細胞成片取代：核偏心、染色質呈鐘面狀、細胞質豐富，並有明顯核旁淡染區，脂肪空泡之間幾乎看不到其他造血細胞，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Hypercellular marrow with sheets of monotonous plasma cells
Eccentric round nuclei with clock-face (cartwheel) chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate to abundant cytoplasm with a pale perinuclear zone
Very few residual hematopoietic elements between fat spaces
Occasional small dark nuclei and fine pigment deposits
1413.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section, stained with a monochrome blue stain (likely a thin plastic-embedded section), shows marrow spaces extensively replaced by sheets of plasma cells. The cells have eccentric round nuclei with clock-face chromatin and small nucleoli, moderate to abundant cytoplasm and a pale perinuclear zone. Residual normal hematopoiesis is sparse between the fat spaces. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by plasma cell myeloma; CD138 and kappa/lambda immunohistochemistry are recommended to confirm clonality and extent.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive glands or nests with larger pleomorphic nuclei and desmoplastic stroma, and is keratin positive rather than CD138/light-chain restricted.
Erythroid precursors have central round dense nuclei with scant cytoplasm and cluster in islands, lacking the eccentric nucleus and hof.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL shows nodular aggregates of small B-cells (CD20+) with plasma cells at the periphery rather than diffuse sheets of pure plasma cells.

1413.stain: Toluidine blue or methylene blue (plastic section)

1285.recognize_zh: 兩顆大小不一的非典型淋巴樣細胞，核呈腎形或凹陷，細胞質淡藍且在核凹處聚集細小嗜天青顆粒，較大那顆明顯大於正常大顆粒淋巴球，提示腫瘤性 NK 細胞。
features: Two atypical lymphoid cells, one large and one medium-sized
Moderate N:C ratio with pale blue, partly clear cytoplasm
Reniform/indented nuclei with the granules nestled in the nuclear hof
Fine to slightly granular chromatin; small nucleolus visible in the smaller cell
Fine azurophilic granules concentrated in a paranuclear zone
Clean cytocentrifuge background
1285.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation shows two isolated atypical lymphoid cells of variable size. Both have indented, kidney-shaped nuclei with fine chromatin and moderate pale blue cytoplasm with a paranuclear collection of fine azurophilic granules; the larger cell exceeds the size of a normal large granular lymphocyte. The morphology indicates atypical granular (NK/cytotoxic) lymphoid cells; immunophenotyping (surface CD3-, cytoplasmic CD3+, CD56+) and EBER in situ hybridization are needed. Findings are consistent with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: T-LGL cells are uniformly small with round mature nuclei and condensed chromatin, and are EBER-negative.
Cytology is similar; distinction rests on the systemic leukemic presentation rather than morphology.
Monocytes have grey-blue cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and vacuoles and lacy folded chromatin, and are CD14+ rather than CD56+/cytoplasmic CD3+.

1221.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中央有一大團血小板聚集，周圍紅血球之間也散在許多單顆血小板，整體血小板數量偏多；左下角的嗜中性球形態正常，紅血球無明顯異常，符合原發性血小板增多症的血小板增多與聚集。
features: Large platelet aggregate in the center of the field
Numerous single platelets scattered between red cells, apparently increased
Platelets of variable size with well-granulated centers
Normocytic, normochromic red cells in rouleaux-like overlap from thick area
Mature segmented neutrophil at lower left without dysplasia
1221.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells without significant poikilocytosis. Platelets are increased, with numerous single platelets of variable size and a large central platelet aggregate. A mature segmented neutrophil is present; no blasts, teardrop cells or nucleated red cells are seen. Platelet clumping can reflect in vitro aggregation, so the platelet count should be interpreted with the smear and repeated in citrate if clumping is extensive. Findings are consistent with thrombocytosis compatible with essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical and molecular context.

ddx.vs: Artifactual clumps occur with a normal or falsely low count and resolve in citrate, whereas here abundant single platelets also indicate true thrombocytosis.
Reactive thrombocytosis shows similar platelets; distinction requires clinical context and JAK2/CALR/MPL testing.
PV also causes thrombocytosis but is defined by an increased hemoglobin/red cell mass and JAK2 mutation, with crowded red cells.

1157.recognize_zh: 普魯士藍鐵染色下，許多有核紅血球的細胞核周圍環繞著藍色含鐵顆粒，形成完整或部分的環狀排列，即環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts）。
features: Numerous erythroid precursors with coarse blue siderotic granules encircling the nucleus (ring sideroblasts)
Granules arranged in a perinuclear ring covering a third or more of the nuclear circumference
Nuclei and cytoplasm counterstained pink with nuclear red/safranin
Clusters of ring sideroblasts within an erythroid-rich area
Background refractile red cells; scattered iron granules outside cells
1157.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained with Prussian blue shows numerous erythroid precursors containing coarse blue iron-positive granules arranged in a perinuclear ring pattern, consistent with ring sideroblasts. The ring sideroblasts are clustered and constitute a substantial proportion of the erythroid cells in this field. In a patient with thrombocytosis, these findings are consistent with the ring sideroblast component of myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis (formerly RARS-T); SF3B1 and JAK2 testing and correlation with megakaryocytic morphology are recommended.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts contain only a few fine scattered granules, not coarse granules encircling one-third or more of the nucleus.

ddx.dx: MDS with SF3B1 mutation / ring sideroblasts
ddx.vs: MDS with ring sideroblasts lacks the persistent thrombocytosis (≥450 x 10^9/L) and MPN-like large megakaryocytes of MDS/MPN-RS-T.

ddx.dx: Secondary sideroblastic anemia (alcohol, copper deficiency, isoniazid, lead)
ddx.vs: Acquired secondary causes resolve with removal of the toxin or copper repletion and lack SF3B1 or other clonal mutations.
Congenital forms present early with microcytic anemia and germline mutations, without thrombocytosis or clonal myeloid features.

1093.recognize_zh: 單核球（monocyte）、帶狀/分節中性球、骨髓細胞（myelocyte）與有核紅血球混雜成團，呈現單核球增多加左移與有核紅血球，符合 JMML 的周邊血液表現。
features: Clustered nucleated cells in a myelomonocytic mixture
Monocytes and promonocyte-like cells with folded nuclei and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm
Left-shifted granulocytes including myelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils, some with hypolobated nuclei
Several nucleated red blood cells with dense round nuclei
Occasional large platelet; red cells without marked poikilocytosis
1093.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of nucleated cells composed of monocytes, immature granulocytes (myelocytes and metamyelocytes), bands and segmented neutrophils, together with several nucleated red blood cells. Monocytes have folded nuclei and gray-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm; occasional neutrophils appear hypolobated. No significant population of blasts is evident in this field. In a young child, findings are consistent with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia, pending correlation with the absolute monocyte count, hemoglobin F and RAS-pathway genetics.

ddx.vs: CML shows a marked granulocytic leukocytosis with myelocyte and neutrophil peaks and basophilia rather than prominent monocytosis, and is BCR::ABL1 positive.

ddx.dx: Reactive monocytosis/leukoerythroblastosis (e.g., viral infection such as CMV/EBV)
ddx.vs: Reactive states lack sustained monocytosis >1x10^9/L with clonal RAS-pathway mutations and usually resolve; morphology alone may not separate them.
CMML shows similar morphology but occurs in older adults; JMML is defined by pediatric age and RAS-pathway alterations.

1029.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見深藍色淋巴細胞浸潤緊貼骨小樑邊緣（綠色箭頭），而骨小樑之間仍是含脂肪與造血細胞的骨髓，典型的骨小樑旁（paratrabecular）淋巴瘤浸潤。
features: Dark basophilic bands of small lymphoid cells lining the surfaces of bony trabeculae (arrows)
Paratrabecular distribution with the infiltrate molded to the bone contour
Background marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis, megakaryocytes, and adipocytes
Area of hemorrhage/aspiration artifact at upper left
1029.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows lymphoid infiltrates in a paratrabecular distribution, forming dense dark bands that hug the surfaces of the bony trabeculae (arrows). The remaining intertrabecular marrow shows trilineage hematopoiesis with adipocytes, and there is focal hemorrhage at the upper left. Findings are consistent with paratrabecular marrow involvement by lymphoma, typical of follicular lymphoma; immunohistochemical confirmation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Benign aggregates are small, well circumscribed and located away from trabeculae, not flattened along the bone surface.
Mantle cell lymphoma may be paratrabecular but expresses CD5 and cyclin D1 and lacks CD10.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma or classic Hodgkin lymphoma
ddx.vs: These produce mixed infiltrates with fibrosis, eosinophils, histiocytes or large atypical cells rather than monotonous small cells lining trabeculae.

4101.recognize_zh: 中央的顆粒球有雙葉核與橘紅色顆粒，可認出是嗜酸性球；但細胞質內顆粒分布不均，並有數個透明空泡（vacuole），屬於活化或脫顆粒的變化；背景可見一顆嗜鹼性點彩（basophilic stippling）紅血球。
features: Eosinophil with a bilobed nucleus and coarse orange-red cytoplasmic granules
Patchy granule loss with several clear cytoplasmic vacuoles (degranulation/activation change)
Background red cells with poikilocytosis including ovalocytes and teardrop-like forms
One red cell with coarse basophilic stippling and a larger polychromatophilic cell at the left
Occasional platelets, some with irregular granular forms
4101.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an eosinophil with a bilobed nucleus and orange-red granules, with patchy loss of granules and several cytoplasmic vacuoles. The background red cells show poikilocytosis with ovalocytes, a cell with coarse basophilic stippling, and a large polychromatophilic red cell. Partially degranulated and vacuolated eosinophils are an activation change seen in reactive eosinophilia and in eosinophilic neoplasms and do not by themselves indicate clonality. Findings are consistent with an activated eosinophil; an absolute eosinophil count and clinical context are needed.

ddx.dx: Neoplastic eosinophil in myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps (hypogranularity, vacuoles), so separation depends on persistent eosinophilia and genetic studies such as PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1 or PCM1::JAK2 rearrangements.
Toxic neutrophils have fine lilac granules, 3-5 nuclear lobes and often Döhle bodies rather than coarse orange granules.
Basophils have purple-black granules that obscure the nucleus rather than refractile orange-red granules.

3781.recognize_zh: 一顆比小淋巴球大的淋巴球，細胞核圓至略腎形偏向一側、染色質成塊，最明顯的是豐富的淡藍色細胞質中散佈數顆粗大的紅紫色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），這就是大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）。
features: Medium-to-large lymphocyte, about 1.5–2 times an RBC
Low N:C ratio with abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented eccentric nucleus with coarse, clumped chromatin; no nucleoli
Several coarse azurophilic (red-purple) granules clustered in the cytoplasm
Background normal RBCs and platelets
3781.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single large granular lymphocyte. The cell has a round to slightly indented nucleus with clumped chromatin and no nucleoli, surrounded by abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing a few coarse azurophilic granules. Background red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings represent large granular lymphocyte morphology, which corresponds to cytotoxic T cells or NK cells; a persistent absolute increase would warrant flow cytometry and TCR clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have deeply basophilic cytoplasm that hugs adjacent RBCs and usually lack discrete azurophilic granules.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and vacuoles.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine cytoplasmic projections, oval nuclei with finer chromatin and no azurophilic granules.

3653.recognize_zh: 胸部正面（A）與側面（B）X 光的箭頭指向胸椎，C 為脊椎矢狀重組影像，虛線箭頭處可見椎體上下終板中央呈方形凹陷、形成「H 形／魚嘴狀」椎體（H-shaped vertebrae），這是鐮刀型貧血骨梗塞造成的典型影像。
features: Composite radiology figure: PA chest radiograph (A), lateral chest radiograph (B) and sagittal spine image (C)
Arrows in A and B point to thoracic vertebral bodies with endplate deformity
Central step-like depressions of the superior and inferior endplates producing H-shaped (Lincoln log) vertebrae, best seen in C (dashed arrow)
Deformity involves multiple contiguous vertebral levels
Lungs appear clear without large focal consolidation in this image
Cellular morphology is not applicable to this image type
3653.describe_en: Composite figure shows PA and lateral chest radiographs and a sagittal image of the spine. Multiple thoracic vertebral bodies demonstrate central, step-like depressions of the superior and inferior endplates with preserved peripheral margins, producing H-shaped ('fish mouth' or Lincoln log) vertebrae, most clearly seen on the sagittal image. No large focal pulmonary consolidation is evident on these views. This is a radiologic image and no cellular morphology is assessable. Findings are consistent with sickle cell spine, caused by microvascular occlusion and infarction of the central endplate supplied by end-arteries with continued peripheral growth.

ddx.vs: Show smooth, gently curved concave endplate deformity rather than sharply marginated central square step-like depressions.
Gaucher can also produce H-shaped vertebrae, and thalassemia shows coarse trabeculae and marrow expansion, so hemoglobin electrophoresis and clinical context are needed to separate them.
Are focal, irregular intravertebral disc herniations, often with anterior wedging, rather than symmetric central endplate depressions across many levels.

3525.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的紅血球內有數個聚集成簇、不規則、藍紫色的小顆粒，偏向細胞周邊（Pappenheimer bodies），這些含鐵顆粒的紅血球即為鐵粒紅血球（siderocytes），可用 Prussian blue 染色證實。
features: Several RBCs containing clusters of multiple small, irregular, blue-purple granules (arrows)
Granules often grouped near the cell periphery
Affected cells include a target-like cell and an ovalocyte
Remaining red cells show mild anisocytosis without inclusions
Scattered platelets in background for comparison
3525.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered erythrocytes containing clusters of small, irregular, basophilic granules, often near the cell periphery, consistent with Pappenheimer bodies (arrows). The remaining red cells show mild anisocytosis. The inclusion-bearing cells correspond to siderocytes, which can be confirmed with an iron (Prussian blue) stain. Siderocytes are seen after splenectomy and in sideroblastic anemias, hemoglobinopathies, and myelodysplastic syndromes.

ddx.vs: Basophilic stippling consists of fine or coarse granules distributed evenly throughout the cell, which are RNA and Prussian blue negative.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single, round, larger dense DNA inclusions rather than clusters of small irregular granules.
Parasites show ring forms with a cytoplasmic rim and chromatin dot (or tetrads in Babesia), not amorphous granule clusters.

3013.recognize_zh: 真皮 H&E 中倍下彌漫的大型非典型細胞，細胞質豐富嗜酸性、核大而多形、可見核仁，並夾雜許多嗜中性球、嗜酸性球與小淋巴球，在皮膚病灶脈絡中符合原發性皮膚退行性大細胞淋巴瘤（CD30+）。
features: Diffuse dermal infiltrate of large atypical cells with abundant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm
Large pleomorphic, oval to kidney-shaped vesicular nuclei with visible nucleoli
Occasional multinucleated or horseshoe-like nuclei suggestive of hallmark cells
Mixed inflammatory background of neutrophils, eosinophils, and small lymphocytes
Loose edematous stroma with collagen bundles and extravasated RBCs
3013.describe_en: Skin biopsy shows a diffuse dermal infiltrate of large atypical cells with abundant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm and large pleomorphic vesicular nuclei with conspicuous nucleoli; some nuclei are kidney-shaped or multilobated. The large cells are admixed with numerous neutrophils, eosinophils, and small lymphocytes in an edematous stroma. Epidermis is not included in this field. Findings are consistent with a CD30-positive large cell lymphoproliferative disorder, supporting primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma when CD30 is expressed by more than 75% of large cells and systemic ALCL is excluded clinically and by ALK staining.

ddx.dx: Lymphomatoid papulosis, type A or C
ddx.vs: LyP shares identical cytology; it is distinguished clinically by recurrent self-healing papules under 2 cm, whereas pcALCL forms larger persistent nodules or tumors.

ddx.dx: Systemic ALK-positive ALCL with skin involvement
ddx.vs: Systemic ALCL is typically ALK-positive with nodal disease, while primary cutaneous ALCL is ALK-negative and confined to skin at staging.

ddx.dx: Mycosis fungoides with large cell transformation
ddx.vs: Transformed MF arises in a patient with prior patches/plaques and epidermotropic small cerebriform cells, with variable CD30 expression.
Carcinoma is keratin-positive and melanoma is S100/SOX10-positive, whereas ALCL cells are CD30-positive and CD45 or T-cell antigen positive.

2629.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片鐵染色中，一小群紅血球前驅細胞裡有藍色鐵顆粒排列在核周；左下方單獨一顆紅母細胞的鐵顆粒幾乎環繞整個細胞核一圈，是典型的環狀鐵粒母細胞。
features: Prussian blue-stained aspirate at medium power with red nuclear counterstain
Isolated erythroid precursor with blue granules forming a near-complete perinuclear ring
Small cluster of erythroid precursors, several with perinuclear siderotic granules
Nearby nucleated cells with fine chromatin lacking iron granules
Sparse cellularity in this field of the smear
2629.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained for iron shows a small cluster of erythroid precursors, several containing coarse blue siderotic granules in a perinuclear distribution. An isolated erythroid precursor in the lower field shows granules nearly completely encircling the nucleus, a classic ring sideroblast. Other nucleated cells in the field lack iron granules. The field is sparsely cellular, so the proportion of ring sideroblasts must be determined by counting across the smear. Findings are consistent with ring sideroblasts, supporting myelodysplastic neoplasm with ring sideroblasts in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts have a few fine scattered granules without a perinuclear ring.
Congenital forms present in young patients with microcytic anemia and may be pyridoxine responsive, whereas MDS-RS occurs in older adults with macrocytic or normocytic anemia and SF3B1 mutation.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: Ring sideroblasts are similar, but this entity has platelets of at least 450 x 10^9/L with large atypical megakaryocytes.

2565.recognize_zh: 抹片被一片單一型態的小至中型淋巴球佔滿，核圓、染色質塊狀、胞質極少，其間夾雜一顆核較大、染色質較淡的前淋巴球／副免疫母細胞，符合 CLL 骨髓浸潤。
features: Dense monotonous population of small to intermediate lymphocytes replacing normal elements
Round to slightly indented nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin
High N:C ratio with scant pale blue cytoplasm
Occasional larger cell with oval nucleus and more open chromatin (prolymphocyte/paraimmunoblast)
Scattered clear vacuoles and red cells in the background; normal hematopoietic precursors not evident
2565.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows near-complete replacement by a monotonous population of small to intermediate-sized lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm. Occasional larger cells with more open chromatin, consistent with prolymphocytes or paraimmunoblasts, are admixed. Normal trilineage hematopoietic precursors are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma, to be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD5+, CD23+, dim sIg).

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma cells have more irregular, cleaved nuclei and are CD23-negative, cyclin D1/SOX11-positive with t(11;14).
LPL includes plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, and is usually CD5- and CD23-.
Hematogones have finely homogeneous chromatin and show a maturing CD10/CD34/TdT immunophenotypic spectrum rather than a clonal CD5+ population.
Richter transformation shows sheets of large cells with nucleoli, whereas here large cells are only occasional within a small cell background.

2501.recognize_zh: 電子顯微鏡下這個細胞的細胞核深度內摺成長條、彎曲的形狀（對應光學顯微鏡的核溝），胞質有溶小體與成束的條紋狀構造，符合蘭格罕細胞的超微結構。
features: Transmission electron micrograph of a large cell with abundant cytoplasm and irregular, bleb-like cell membrane
Elongated, deeply folded/cleaved nucleus with an infolding that creates a groove
Scattered electron-dense membrane-bound granules (lysosomes) and mitochondria
Parallel striated arrays in the cytoplasm at left and lower right, possibly aggregated Birbeck granules; not resolvable with certainty at this magnification
Adjacent cells at the edges of the field
2501.describe_en: Transmission electron microscopy shows a large mononuclear cell with an irregular, vesicle-studded plasma membrane and abundant cytoplasm. The nucleus is elongated and deeply folded with a longitudinal infolding, the ultrastructural correlate of the nuclear groove. The cytoplasm contains electron-dense lysosomes, mitochondria and parallel striated membranous arrays; individual Birbeck granule morphology cannot be confirmed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a Langerhans cell in Langerhans cell histiocytosis, with higher-magnification views needed to document Birbeck granules.

ddx.vs: Macrophages have round to kidney-shaped nuclei with abundant phagolysosomes and no Birbeck granules.
Interdigitating cells show complex interlocking processes and lack Birbeck granules.
Mast cells contain numerous uniform electron-dense granules with scroll or lattice substructure rather than rod-shaped Birbeck granules.

2373.recognize_zh: 整個視野幾乎都是只剩淡粉紅細胞膜輪廓的「鬼影細胞」（ghost cells），代表成人血紅素 HbA 已被酸洗脫；只有中央一顆紅血球染色稍深，這是 Kleihauer-Betke 酸洗脫法的判讀畫面。
features: Nearly all red cells appear as pale 'ghost' cells with only a faint pink membrane outline and empty interior (HbA eluted)
A single red cell near the center retains slightly more diffuse pink staining, of intermediate intensity
No clearly dark, uniformly stained HbF-containing (fetal) cells in this field
Cells lie in cohesive sheets and chains; background shows fine eosinophilic precipitate
No nucleated cells present
2373.describe_en: Kleihauer-Betke acid elution preparation of peripheral blood shows red cells almost entirely converted to pale ghost cells, indicating elution of acid-labile adult hemoglobin.
