A single cell in the center retains slightly denser pink staining, but no clearly intensely stained fetal-type (HbF-rich) cells are identified in this field. Findings represent a predominantly negative field; quantitation requires counting fetal cells across many fields (typically 2,000 cells) against an adult control.

ddx.vs: A positive maternal sample shows a discrete population of brightly eosinophilic, uniformly stained fetal cells among ghost cells, rather than a nearly all-ghost field.

ddx.dx: Heterocellular increase in HbF (F cells in hemoglobinopathy)
ddx.vs: F cells show variable, often intermediate staining in a subset of cells, which can mimic fetal cells and requires flow cytometry for anti-HbF/anti-carbonic anhydrase to separate.

ddx.dx: Pancellular hereditary persistence of fetal hemoglobin
ddx.vs: In pancellular HPFH essentially all red cells retain moderate, even staining rather than appearing as ghosts.

2181.recognize_zh: 高倍小腸絨毛：上皮排列尚完整並有杯狀細胞，上皮內散在小淋巴球，固有層水腫、細胞稀疏；本視野沒有明顯腫瘤細胞，較像淋巴瘤旁的黏膜變化，只能部分支持題目。
features: Single small-intestinal villus lined by columnar enterocytes with goblet cells
Scattered intraepithelial lymphocytes within the surface epithelium
Edematous, loosely cellular lamina propria with scattered lymphocytes, plasma cells and a few eosinophils
Brush border preserved; no villous atrophy evident in this villus
No sheets of atypical lymphoid cells in this field
2181.describe_en: High-power section of small-intestinal mucosa shows a villus lined by columnar enterocytes with goblet cells and scattered intraepithelial lymphocytes. The lamina propria is edematous and contains scattered lymphocytes, plasma cells and occasional eosinophils. No sheets of atypical lymphoid cells or mucosal destruction are identified in this field, and villous architecture of the illustrated villus is relatively preserved. These findings may represent mucosa adjacent to enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma, but are not diagnostic by themselves; quantification of intraepithelial lymphocytes with CD3/CD8 and evaluation of the tumor are required.

ddx.vs: Normal mucosa has fewer than about 25 intraepithelial lymphocytes per 100 enterocytes, which requires CD3 counting to exclude increased IELs.
Celiac disease shows increased intraepithelial lymphocytes, often with villous blunting and crypt hyperplasia, with polyclonal, phenotypically normal T cells.
RCD II has intraepithelial lymphocytes with aberrant loss of surface CD3/CD8 and clonal TCR rearrangement, detectable only by IHC/flow and molecular studies.

2117.recognize_zh: 中央的嗜中性球核只分成兩個對稱的圓形葉片，中間以細窄的染色質橋相連，形似夾鼻眼鏡（pince-nez），染色質粗糙團塊狀，胞質有顆粒，這就是 Pelger-Huët 細胞。
features: Mature neutrophil with bilobed nucleus of two symmetric round lobes (pince-nez configuration)
Lobes connected by a thin chromatin bridge
Coarse, markedly clumped mature chromatin
Cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules and preserved granularity
Normal cell size; background red cells unremarkable
2117.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at oil immersion shows a mature neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus composed of two symmetric round lobes joined by a thin chromatin bridge, in a pince-nez configuration. The chromatin is coarse and markedly clumped, and the cytoplasm contains fine neutrophilic granules. Findings are consistent with a Pelger-Huët cell; distinction between inherited Pelger-Huët anomaly and acquired pseudo-Pelger-Huët change requires assessment of the proportion of affected neutrophils, presence of hypogranulation or other dysplasia, and clinical history.

ddx.vs: Acquired change affects a variable subset of neutrophils and is often accompanied by hypogranulation and other dysplasia, whereas inherited anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils with normal granules.
Band neutrophils have a curved, non-segmented nucleus of uniform width without a thin bridge between two round lobes.
Eosinophils are also bilobed but contain large orange-red refractile granules.
Metamyelocytes have a kidney-shaped nucleus with less condensed chromatin and no lobation.

2053.recognize_zh: 這是低倍免疫組織化學染色（綠色對比染色），棕黑色陽性訊號只出現在數個結節狀區域，呈不規則、破碎的網狀分布，結節間區域陰性；最可能是標示濾泡樹突細胞網（如 CD21/CD23）的染色，突顯濾泡性淋巴瘤中擴張且變形的濾泡結構，但圖上未標明抗體。
features: Low-power immunohistochemical stain with brown-black chromogen and methyl green counterstain
Positive staining confined to several nodular (follicle-shaped) regions
Staining within nodules is irregular, fragmented and meshwork-like rather than uniform cellular
Interfollicular areas are negative
Antibody is not labeled; pattern most resembles a follicular dendritic cell marker (e.g. CD21/CD23)
2053.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical preparation with methyl green counterstain shows positive brown-black staining restricted to multiple nodular follicle-like areas, with a coarse, irregular and fragmented meshwork pattern. The interfollicular areas are negative. The antibody is not specified, but the distribution most closely resembles expanded, disrupted follicular dendritic cell meshworks. In the context of follicular lymphoma, these findings highlight the nodular follicular architecture of the neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles show compact, well-circumscribed FDC meshworks of variable size, and confirmation relies on BCL2-negative germinal centers.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: Colonized follicles show fragmented, disrupted CD21 meshworks but the neoplastic cells are CD10 negative.
AITL shows extrafollicular expanded CD21 meshworks around high endothelial venules rather than meshworks confined to discrete nodules.

1989.recognize_zh: 整片黏著成片的大型細胞，核為泡狀染色質並有明顯的中央嗜酸性核仁；箭頭指出一顆多核、類似 Reed-Sternberg 的奇異巨細胞，符合大 B 細胞淋巴瘤間變型的多形性表現。
features: Diffuse sheets of large cells with abundant amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm
Round to oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin and prominent central eosinophilic nucleoli
Arrow: multinucleated/multilobated bizarre cell with Reed-Sternberg-like features
Occasional mitotic figures and apoptotic cells
Paucity of background small lymphocytes, giving a cohesive, carcinoma-like appearance
1989.describe_en: Sections show diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, vesicular chromatin, and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli. Scattered bizarre multinucleated cells with Reed-Sternberg-like morphology are present (arrow), along with mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies. Background small lymphocytes are sparse and the growth pattern is cohesive. Findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant, pending immunohistochemical confirmation of B-cell lineage.

ddx.vs: ALCL has horseshoe-shaped hallmark cells and is CD30-strong, ALK-positive or negative, with loss of B-cell markers, whereas this entity expresses CD20/PAX5.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD15/CD30-positive with weak PAX5 and CD20/CD45 negativity, unlike the strong B-cell program of DLBCL.
Cohesive sheets with prominent nucleoli can mimic carcinoma, which is separated by keratin positivity and CD45 negativity.

1861.recognize_zh: 胚細胞大小不一，部分較大且有明顯核仁與較多淡藍色細胞質，箭頭所指細胞有一端延伸的細胞質尾巴（手鏡狀，hand-mirror），無顆粒與 Auer 小體，呈異質性（類 FAB L2）淋巴母細胞外觀。
features: Heterogeneous blasts ranging from small to large
Moderate N:C ratio in larger blasts with pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and visible nucleoli in some cells
Cytoplasmic tail / hand-mirror (uropod) configuration (arrow)
Admixed small mature lymphocytes and a basophilic cell at lower right; no Auer rods
1861.describe_en: Smear shows a heterogeneous population of small to large blasts with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, visible nucleoli in the larger cells and a moderate rim of pale blue, agranular cytoplasm. Some blasts have a unipolar cytoplasmic tail (hand-mirror form, arrow). Occasional small mature lymphocytes are admixed, and Auer rods or granules are not seen. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia with L2-type morphology, compatible with B-lymphoblastic leukemia pending flow cytometry (CD19, CD10, CD22, TdT).

ddx.vs: AML blasts can look similar, but MPO positivity (≥3%), Auer rods and CD13/CD33/CD117 expression favor myeloid lineage.
T-ALL is morphologically indistinguishable and is separated by cytoplasmic CD3 and absence of B-lineage markers on flow cytometry.
Hematogones are small with homogeneous chromatin, no nucleoli, and show a normal maturation continuum on flow rather than a monotonous aberrant blast population.

1797.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆大細胞含四個彼此分開、大小一致的卵圓形細胞核，細胞質豐富、淡紫藍色帶細小紫紅顆粒且邊緣不規則，是蝕骨細胞（osteoclast）的典型樣子。
features: Large multinucleated cell, many times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Four discrete, uniform oval nuclei with evenly dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous small nucleoli
Abundant pale blue-lilac cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and irregular, frayed cell borders
Nuclei are separate and not connected, unlike a lobulated megakaryocyte nucleus
Background of normocytic red cells and scattered platelets
1797.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large multinucleated cell with four separate, evenly sized oval nuclei with fine chromatin and abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules. The cell borders are irregular. The nuclei are discrete and uniform rather than a single lobulated nucleus. Findings are consistent with an osteoclast.

ddx.vs: A megakaryocyte has one large multilobated nucleus with interconnected lobes and granular cytoplasm often shedding platelets, not multiple separate uniform nuclei.
Osteoblasts are individual mononuclear cells with eccentric nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and a perinuclear clear zone distant from the nucleus.

ddx.dx: Multinucleated plasma cell or tumor giant cell
ddx.vs: Neoplastic multinucleated cells show nuclear pleomorphism, variable nuclear size, and prominent nucleoli, whereas osteoclast nuclei are uniform and bland.

1669.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆單獨的漿細胞樣細胞：核圓略偏位、染色質塊狀，細胞質量中等、呈顆粒狀藍紫色；背景散在血小板。單一細胞無法確定是否為漿細胞白血病，需計數與流式確認。
features: Single circulating cell of small-to-medium size
Round, slightly eccentric nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin
Moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm with a finely granular texture
No distinct perinuclear hof clearly resolved
Background normocytic red cells and scattered platelets
1669.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single small-to-medium cell with a round, slightly eccentric nucleus, clumped chromatin and a moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm; a perinuclear hof is not clearly resolved. Background red cells and platelets are unremarkable. The cell is compatible with a circulating plasma cell, but a single cell cannot distinguish plasma cell leukemia from a plasmacytoid lymphocyte; quantification of circulating plasma cells and flow cytometry for a clonal CD38+/CD138+ population are needed.

ddx.vs: Has a more central nucleus and less abundant cytoplasm without a Golgi hof; flow cytometry shows CD19/CD20 expression rather than a CD138+ phenotype.
Morphologically identical as a single cell; distinguished by polytypic light-chain expression and low numbers.
An early erythroid precursor has a central round nucleus with finer chromatin and deeply blue agranular cytoplasm, and usually occurs with other nucleated red cells.

63365.recognize_zh: 視野中有三顆細胞質充滿粗大橘紅色顆粒、核為雙葉或分葉的嗜酸性球（eosinophil），左側另有一顆核深紫、細胞質淡藍的淋巴球可作大小與顏色對照。
features: Three granulocytes slightly larger than red cells, each with cytoplasm packed with coarse, uniform orange-red granules
Nuclei bilobed to irregularly lobated with condensed, clumped chromatin; granules do not obscure the nucleus
Left-sided lymphocyte with a round-to-notched nucleus, coarse chromatin and a moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Background normocytic, normochromic red cells without significant poikilocytosis; rare platelets
63365.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with a small number of platelets. Three eosinophils are present, each with a bilobed to lobated nucleus and abundant cytoplasm filled with coarse, refractile orange-red granules. A small mature lymphocyte with a round, slightly indented nucleus and a modest rim of pale blue cytoplasm is present at the left for comparison. No immature or dysplastic cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with mature eosinophils; clustering of three in one field raises the possibility of eosinophilia, which should be confirmed by absolute count.

ddx.vs: Basophil granules are dark purple-black, larger and irregular and typically obscure the nucleus, whereas eosinophil granules are uniform orange-red and leave the nucleus visible.
Toxic granules are dark purple-blue and scattered in pale pink cytoplasm of a multilobed nucleus, not the densely packed orange-red granules seen here.
An eosinophilic myelocyte has a round, non-lobed nucleus and may contain some dark basophilic-staining immature granules, unlike these mature bilobed forms.

60933.recognize_zh: 兩片卵圓形核葉分開排列，細胞質內滿是大而圓、帶折光感的橘紅色顆粒，細胞質基底略帶淡藍，是成熟嗜酸性球（eosinophil）。
features: Granulocyte slightly larger than surrounding red cells
Bilobed nucleus with two oval lobes and condensed chromatin
Abundant coarse, round, refractile orange-red granules filling the cytoplasm
Faintly basophilic cytoplasmic background visible between granules at the periphery
Background red cells include several elongated/oval forms
60933.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high magnification shows a granulocyte with a bilobed nucleus composed of two oval lobes with condensed chromatin. The cytoplasm is filled with coarse, round, refractile orange-red granules set in a faintly basophilic background, and the granules do not obscure the nucleus. Adjacent red cells include several oval forms. Findings are consistent with a mature eosinophil.

ddx.vs: Basophil granules are dark purple-black, irregular in size and typically obscure the nucleus.
Eosinophilic myelocytes have a single round nucleus without lobation and may contain some darker immature granules.
Toxic neutrophils have a multilobed nucleus and dark purple granules in pale pink cytoplasm, not refractile orange granules.

60293.recognize_zh: 中央的幼紅血球體積大，細胞質已呈灰粉紅色（已有血紅素），但核仍大而染色質呈疏鬆、篩孔狀（sieve-like），核質發育不同步（nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony），符合巨母紅血球性幼紅血球（megaloblastic erythroid precursor）。
features: Markedly enlarged erythroid precursor, several times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Large round nucleus with open, finely stippled sieve-like chromatin despite cytoplasmic maturity
Abundant gray-pink partially hemoglobinized cytoplasm (polychromatophilic stage)
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony: nucleus appears younger than the cytoplasm
Marrow aspirate background with other precursors and red cells
60293.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly enlarged erythroid precursor with abundant gray-pink, partially hemoglobinized cytoplasm. The nucleus is large and round with open, finely granular sieve-like chromatin, which is immature relative to the degree of cytoplasmic hemoglobinization. Other hematopoietic precursors are present at the periphery of the field. Findings are consistent with a megaloblastic erythroid precursor showing nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, as seen in vitamin B12 or folate deficiency, drug effect, or dyserythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: A normal polychromatophilic normoblast is smaller with a condensed, coarsely clumped nucleus appropriate to its hemoglobinized cytoplasm.
MDS megaloblastoid precursors look similar but occur with normal B12/folate and other dysplastic features (ring sideroblasts, dysgranulopoiesis, abnormal megakaryocytes).
Plasma cells have an eccentric nucleus with clock-face chromatin, deep blue cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof rather than gray-pink hemoglobinized cytoplasm.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of deeply basophilic, often vacuolated proerythroblasts comprising at least 80% of marrow cells, not isolated maturing megaloblastic cells.

133.recognize_zh: 背部瀰漫性紅皮症（erythroderma），周邊血可見核呈腦迴狀溝紋（cerebriform）或深裂的非典型淋巴球；流式 CD3 閘內 CD4+ 細胞大量擴增、CD4:CD8 明顯升高，且大多失去 CD7 與 CD26，符合 Sezary 症候群。
features: Small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio and scant rim of pale to basophilic cytoplasm
Nuclei with cerebriform convolutions: fine linear grooves/folds across the nucleus and deep clefts producing bilobed or kidney-shaped contours
Dense, hyperchromatic chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli
No cytoplasmic granules or blebs
Flow (CD3 gate): marked expansion of CD4+CD8- T cells with only a small CD8+ population (CD4:CD8 ratio well above 10)
Flow: the expanded CD4+ population is largely CD7-negative and CD26-negative; clinical photo shows confluent erythroderma of the back
133.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows confluent erythema involving essentially the entire visible skin of the back and shoulders (erythroderma) with scattered small papular lesions. Peripheral blood smear shows numerous atypical small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with hyperchromatic nuclei displaying cerebriform grooves and deep nuclear clefts, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant agranular cytoplasm. Flow cytometry gated on CD3+ T cells shows a markedly expanded CD4+ population with very few CD8+ cells; the majority of CD4+ cells lack CD7 and CD26, with only small residual CD7+ and CD26+ CD4+ subsets. Findings are consistent with Sezary syndrome.

ddx.vs: ATLL cells are typically polylobated 'flower cells' rather than grooved cerebriform nuclei, and ATLL is CD25 bright with HTLV-1 positivity and often hypercalcemia.
T-PLL shows visible nucleoli and cytoplasmic blebs, retains bright CD7, and expresses TCL1 via TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement, whereas these cells are CD7 and CD26 negative.

ddx.dx: Erythroderma of benign inflammatory cause (e.g., drug reaction, atopic/psoriatic erythroderma)
ddx.vs: Reactive erythroderma can have occasional circulating cerebriform cells but lacks a large CD4+ population with CD7/CD26 loss, a CD4:CD8 ratio >10, and a clonal TCR rearrangement matched to skin.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphocytes / normal CD4+ T cells
ddx.vs: Normal T cells retain CD7 and CD26 in most CD4+ cells and lack the nuclear grooving seen here.

captions: Clinical photo: generalized erythroderma of the back with scattered papules
PB smear: atypical lymphoid cells, one with irregular folded nucleus and two with dense hyperchromatic nuclei
PB smear, high power: Sezary cell with cerebriform nuclear grooves
PB smear, high power: atypical lymphocyte with deeply cleft, bilobed-appearing nucleus
Flow CD4 vs CD8 (CD3 gate): dominant CD4+CD8- population with a small CD8+ subset
Flow CD4 vs CD7 (CD3 gate): most CD4+ cells are CD7-negative
Flow CD4 vs CD26 (CD3 gate): most CD4+ cells are CD26-negative

69.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片鐵染色（Prussian blue）可見多個紅血球前驅細胞核周圍環繞一圈藍色含鐵顆粒，即環形鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts）；周邊血與骨髓其他系列形態大致正常，配合貧血與 SF3B1 突變，符合 MDS-RS 單系發育不良。
features: Prussian blue aspirate: multiple erythroid precursors with coarse blue siderotic granules forming a perinuclear ring encircling at least one-third of the nucleus (ring sideroblasts)
Aspirate: erythroid precursors at all stages with some showing mildly megaloblastoid, open chromatin; granulocytic maturation present without obvious dysgranulopoiesis
Core biopsy: cellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis, clusters of erythroid precursors and megakaryocytes of normal size and lobation; focal interstitial edema/hemorrhage
Peripheral blood: normocytic RBCs with mild anisopoikilocytosis (occasional elliptocytes, teardrop and crenated cells), adequate platelets
Peripheral blood neutrophil with normal granulation and no convincing pseudo-Pelger-Huet change
69.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis including occasional elliptocytes and teardrop forms; platelets appear adequate and the neutrophils seen are normally granulated. The bone marrow core biopsy is cellular with trilineage hematopoiesis, erythroid clusters and megakaryocytes of normal size and nuclear lobation, without increased blasts. The aspirate shows erythroid precursors at all stages of maturation, some with mildly megaloblastoid chromatin, and granulocytic maturation without obvious dysplasia. Iron stain shows numerous ring sideroblasts with coarse siderotic granules encircling at least one-third of the nuclear circumference. In the setting of anemia, exclusion of reactive causes and an SF3B1 mutation, findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with ring sideroblasts and single lineage dysplasia (MDS-RS-SLD).

ddx.dx: Congenital or acquired non-clonal sideroblastic anemia (alcohol, copper deficiency, zinc toxicity, isoniazid)
ddx.vs: Reactive sideroblastic anemias can show identical ring sideroblasts, so the discriminator is clinical history, copper/zinc levels and absence of an SF3B1 mutation or clonal cytogenetic abnormality.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: MDS/MPN-RS-T has a platelet count of at least 450,000/uL with large MPN-like megakaryocytes, whereas this patient has a normal platelet count and megakaryocytes of normal morphology.
MDS-RS-MLD requires dysplasia in at least 10% of cells of two or more lineages, whereas dysplasia here is essentially confined to the erythroid lineage.

B12/folate deficiency gives macrocytosis, hypersegmented neutrophils, giant metamyelocytes and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony without numerous ring sideroblasts, and the vitamin B12 level is normal in this patient.

captions: Peripheral blood: mild anisopoikilocytosis with lymphocytes and adequate platelets
Peripheral blood: normally granulated neutrophil and occasional poikilocytes
Bone marrow biopsy: megakaryocytes and erythroid precursors in edematous stroma
Bone marrow biopsy: cellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and normal-appearing megakaryocytes
Aspirate: erythroid and granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation
Aspirate: erythroid precursors, some with megaloblastoid chromatin
Prussian blue: numerous ring sideroblasts with perinuclear siderotic granules

60485.recognize_zh: 免疫染色中一群大型腫瘤細胞呈強烈的細胞質與膜陽性，部分有核旁點狀加強（Golgi 區），背景小細胞為陰性；依描述為 CD3 陽性的大細胞，對應 ALK 陽性未分化大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）。
features: Numerous large tumor cells with strong cytoplasmic and membranous positivity
Perinuclear/paranuclear dot-like accentuation in many cells (Golgi pattern)
Large, round to kidney-shaped nuclei visible as negative centers within stained cytoplasm
Cohesive-appearing sheet-like distribution of positive cells
Intervening negative background cells with blue hematoxylin counterstain
60485.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (reported as CD3) shows a dense population of large neoplastic cells with strong cytoplasmic and membranous staining, frequently with paranuclear Golgi-type accentuation, while intervening smaller background cells are negative. The positive cells have large round to reniform nuclei. CD3 is lost in a majority of ALK-positive ALCL, so positivity here is an uncommon but recognized finding; diagnosis rests on strong uniform CD30 and ALK expression. Findings support a T-cell lineage large cell lymphoma, consistent with the provided diagnosis of ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Morphologically and CD30-identical, but lacks ALK protein expression and ALK rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS with CD30 expression
ddx.vs: Shows more heterogeneous, weaker CD30 staining and lacks the uniform hallmark cell population and ALK expression.
Reed-Sternberg cells are CD15/PAX5 weakly positive, usually CD3 and EMA negative, and scattered in an inflammatory background rather than forming sheets.
Cohesive large cells in sinuses may mimic ALCL but express keratin or S100/SOX10 and lack T-cell markers and CD30/ALK.

3589.recognize_zh: 大型淋巴球的胞質豐富、淡藍色，靠近邊緣（與紅血球接觸處）顏色較深，胞質被周圍紅血球擠壓出稜角形外廓，核大、形狀不規則、染色質略疏鬆；這種「抱住紅血球」的外觀是反應性（非典型）淋巴球的特徵。
features: Large lymphocyte with an irregular, angular outline molded by adjacent red cells
Abundant cytoplasm that is pale centrally with deeper basophilia at the periphery where it contacts red cells
Large irregular nucleus with moderately condensed but somewhat open chromatin; no distinct nucleolus
No cytoplasmic granules or vacuoles
Background red cells normochromic
3589.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with abundant cytoplasm whose borders are indented and molded by adjacent erythrocytes, with peripheral cytoplasmic basophilia accentuated at points of contact. The nucleus is large and irregular with moderately condensed chromatin and no conspicuous nucleolus. The cell lacks granules and vacuoles. Findings are consistent with a reactive (atypical, Downey type II) lymphocyte, as seen in viral infections such as infectious mononucleosis.

ddx.vs: Blasts have a high N:C ratio, fine immature chromatin with nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, unlike this cell's abundant cytoplasm and more mature chromatin.
Monocytes have gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm with fine granules and a folded lacy nucleus, without peripheral basophilia molding around red cells.
Hairy cells have oval or bean-shaped nuclei with circumferential fine hair-like projections and are CD11c/CD25/CD103-positive B cells.
LGLs contain discrete azurophilic granules and have a round condensed nucleus.
